features.detail: Injects a save button on each ad in supported libraries and feeds. features.limits_or_cost: Needs active subscription or trial; ad blockers off; desktop only. Cmd+Shift+R resets the extension.

features.detail: Click the floating Foreplay icon on the page to open the extension modal, click Board Settings, pick a default folder or board, click Apply. Every save button on the page then targets that board, but each ad still needs its own save click.

(2) Same, but toggle Add Manually, paste the brand's Facebook Ad Library URL into the Facebook Ad Library field, pick folder, Add Spyder Brand. (3) From Discovery brand avatar > Track Brand in Spyder > choose folder. Active ads load in 5-10 minutes; manual adds start collecting immediately.
features.limits_or_cost: Workflow 15 brands, Agency 50 brands, unlimited on annual billing; Basic none. Product page also says 2 brands free across all plans (conflicts with billing note that legacy plans lost the 2 free credits).
features.notable: Paste-a-library-URL fallback means any page can be tracked even if not in the index.

features.detail: Scrapes Meta Ad Library 24/7 for every ad a tracked brand launches on Meta platforms (Facebook, Instagram), with enriched metadata. Ads are kept forever even after Meta removes them. Brands other users already track come with shared history: 20,000-25,000+ brands back to August 2023, up to 3 years.
features.limits_or_cost: Refresh interval unverified.
features.notable: Pooled history: the first customer to track a brand back-fills it for everyone after.

features.feature: Competitor Creative Tests with Winner Identified badge
features.detail: Tab on a Spyder brand page. Groups the competitor's ads by launch date into cohorts and tracks each ad's active or inactive status over time. When only one ad in a cohort is still running the group gets a Winner Identified badge. Click an ad to open its drawer.
features.limits_or_cost: Exact cohort detection logic unverified.
features.notable: Infers a winner with zero performance data: last survivor of a batch launched together.

features.feature: Competitor Hooks tab with pin and export
features.detail: All video ads in Spyder are auto-transcribed and their hooks listed in one tab. Pin specific hooks, then export as CSV or copy all to clipboard. Marketed as Top Performing Hooks / Hook Export.
features.limits_or_cost: Hook extraction rule and ranking unverified.
features.notable: A hook bank per competitor, exportable straight into a brief.

features.detail: Landing Pages tab lists every landing page a tracked competitor sends paid social traffic to, each with Desktop and Mobile screenshots, downloadable. Marketing claims it shows which offers and pages get the most ad spend and creative distribution.

Historical timeline of a competitor's creative launches. Date range back up to 3 years; filter by format, platform, language, launch status, niche; sort most recent, earliest, longest running. Visualizes ad lifespans.
Spyder shows at a glance how many images, videos and carousels a competitor is running right now.
Slack & Email Updates deliver new competitor creative; Automated Competitor Reporting sends a competitor summary to the inbox; Share Competitor Reports with colleagues or clients.
features.limits_or_cost: Frequency and thresholds unverified.

features.detail: app.foreplay.co/lens > Connect Ad Account > name the Lens brand, set currency and reporting timezone > pick platform > OAuth pop-up via Orcabase from Triple Whale (no Triple Whale account needed) > Next. Usable once 7 days of history import. Settings include Default Attribution Window, Goal Metric, Industry / Niche, Average Order Value, GMV / Revenue.
features.limits_or_cost: Lens brands: Workflow 1, Agency 10, Enterprise unlimited; $50 per extra brand. Flat price, not tied to ad spend.
features.notable: Uses a third-party connector (Orcabase) instead of building ad API sync in-house.

features.detail: Five 0-100 percentile scores comparing an ad against your own ads on the same Lens brand, per dollar spent: Hook Score (3-second hook rate, video), Watch Score (ThruPlay, video), Click Score (clicks), Convert Score (conversions, 7-day click / 1-day view), Viral Engagement Score (likes + comments + shares).
features.notable: Percentile vs own history makes scores budget-neutral and easy to read; engagement score fits organic content.

features.feature: Lens Top Performing and Comparison reports
features.detail: Overview > New > Create Report > Top Performing Report. Group by Ad Name (default), Creative, Copy, Headline or Landing Page. Date picker top right shows only ads with spend in range. Filters: Active Status, Campaign Name, Spend. Views: bar (up to 5 metrics), line (2), card (10); Add Metric; pin columns. Attribution toggles None/1/7/28 day for click and view. Comparison Reports compare groups of ads. Share and export reports.

Your metrics plotted against a real-time median of 20,000+ advertisers on a scale with a black centre dot (left worse, right better). Updates daily. Segments by GMV and AOV tiers and 13 physical-product niches.
features.limits_or_cost: eCommerce only; lead gen benchmarks coming soon.

features.detail: Automated creative inspiration drawn from Discovery top-performing ads, tied to the ad accounts connected to Lens. Suggested weekly check.
features.limits_or_cost: Matching logic unverified.
features.notable: Puts inspiration inside the analytics screen so the next idea sits beside the result.

features.detail: Auto-enriches your own ads with AI tags: Persona Targeting, Top Themes, Facial Recognition, Hook Transcription, Video Transcription; plus Custom Tagging by creative ID and Manual Rating.

Account Settings > select Lens account > Guest Users > invite. Existing users get an email to join; new users create a guest account with all other Foreplay features locked. Report links also support password protection and IP tracking of viewers.
features.limits_or_cost: Free (Aug 2025).

features.detail: Generates ad scripts from inputs: product name, company name, target audience, language. Regenerate Versions creates new hooks, CTAs and copy variants for split tests; Multi-Language translates script or storyboard into 150+ languages.
features.limits_or_cost: AI Script Generator unlimited per pricing table.

features.feature: Storyboard generator with AI sketch frames
features.detail: Builds a scene-by-scene storyboard: Scene Descriptions (action per scene), AI Storyboard Images (sketch per scene), Converting Text Overlay (on-screen text), AI Scene Iterations.
Attach Inspiration / Embeded Inspiration adds competitor or own ads from the Swipe File into the brief as references, so the brief carries the source ad.
features.notable: Source-to-brief link is the swipe-then-remix bridge.

features.detail: Reusable brand info (colors, fonts, brand guidelines) added to a brief in one click; separate profiles per brand for agencies.

Modular Details Builder with prebuilt content blocks; Creative Brief Template to save reusable templates and script formats; due dates and work-back schedules; Dynamic Deliverables list. Export to PDF, Sheets and more. Older update added Loom links and table view.
features.limits_or_cost: Briefs available on all current plans.

features.feature: Public brief pages and asset collection
features.detail: Share a brief by link with clients or creators; Branded Brief Pages add agency branding and a point of contact; Collect Assets lets one or many contributors submit finished creative against the brief.
features.notable: Brief link doubles as the creator upload portal.

features.detail: Key from app.foreplay.co/api-overview, sent in Authorization header. Products: Spyder, Discovery, Swipe File. Example endpoint search-and-filter-ads with query, live, display_format, publisher_platform, language, order=longest_running. Returns video and thumbnail, headline, description, category, niche, language, running duration, timestamps, full transcription, CTA, display format, AI emotion analysis. Request logs at app.foreplay.co/api-logs filterable by IP, country, endpoint, status. Docs at public.api.foreplay.co/docs.
features.limits_or_cost: 1 ad = 1 credit. 10,000 credits/mo on all current plans, 20,000 on annual (granted upfront). Packs: 100k $99/mo, 250k $189/mo, 500k $349/mo. No rollover. Legacy plans excluded.
features.notable: Per-ad credit pricing is simple to meter.

features.detail: Server URL public.api.foreplay.co/mcp; add as a custom connector named Foreplay, sign in and approve. Works in Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Cursor, Codex, Claude Code. Exposes 200M+ ads plus your boards and swipe files (and Lens data if connected). Per ad: creative, copy, CTA, landing page URL, transcript, active flag, run length. Example asks: find long-running video ads in a category; summarize a brand's hooks, offers, CTAs, landing pages; group swipe file by creative angle; weekly competitor review.
features.limits_or_cost: Included on paid plans (Basic, Workflow, Agency) per pricing table.
features.notable: Lets the customer's own AI do the remix and briefing on top of the library.

features.detail: Help guides for n8n, Clay and Gumloop on top of the API; Zapier mentioned for custom workflows.
features.limits_or_cost: Uses API credits.

features.detail: Basic, Workflow, Agency, Enterprise. 7-day free trial (no credit card per Spyder page). Annual toggle label: Save 15% + Unlimited Spyder. Saves unlimited on every plan.
features.limits_or_cost: Basic $59 ($49 annual), Workflow $175 ($149), Agency $459 ($389), Enterprise custom; +$20/user; +$50/Lens brand.
features.notable: Unlimited saves on the entry plan; gates competitor tracking and analytics instead.

features.feature: Brand Request by Ad Library URL
features.detail: Inspo tab > Discovery > Brand Request (top right) opens a window; paste a brand's Meta Ad Library URL, click Submit request, Atria pulls the brand's ad data.
features.limits_or_cost: Counts toward follow quota when followed.

features.feature: Brand Overview with top hooks and personas
features.detail: A brand's Overview tab summarizes its Meta ads: highest-performing creatives, hooks and personas. Brand ads sortable by time, format, video length, language, status. Discovery can filter by Industry to see category patterns. Atria flags repeating hooks, formats or offers across ads and weeks; insights can move into a brief.
features.limits_or_cost: AI insights on followed brands only from Plus up.
features.notable: Brand page answers 'what is working for them' before the user scrolls a single ad.

features.feature: Follow brands with quota and locking
features.detail: Follow by brand ID, advertiser ID or Meta Ads Library URL (with view_all_page_id). Following is idempotent (created false if already followed). Response returns quota used/limit/over and tracked_advertiser_ids. Over quota, newest follows stay active and oldest get locked (still listed, flagged locked). URL follows trigger an async collection request.
features.limits_or_cost: Core 50, Plus 100, Business 200, Enterprise custom.
features.notable: Lock-oldest instead of hard-blocking keeps data but enforces the plan cap.

features.detail: A brand groups several advertiser pages (roster). Users can manually track an individual advertiser (tracked true/false). Tracking source is manual, brand_follow or brand_coverage; automatic coverage from a followed brand does not count against the manual cap.
features.limits_or_cost: Manual advertiser allowance per plan, value unverified.
features.notable: Brand vs page split handles multi-page advertisers (regional pages, sub-brands).

features.detail: Filters: query (title, body, brand), platform (facebook, instagram, messenger, audience_network, threads, whatsapp, tiktok, linkedin), display_format (image, video, carousel, multi_images, multi_videos, dco, dpa), video_length buckets (0-15, 15-30, 30-60, 60-120, 120+), language (ISO), status active/inactive, cta (30 normalized), theme (31 keys e.g. problem_solution, discount, testimonial, UGC, before_after), body length, creative duplicates, link_url, launched_after/before, active_since, min/max_days_running, brand include/exclude, following-only, industry, partner_ads, target countries include/exclude, audience age and gender, Facebook page likes.
features.limits_or_cost: page_size 1-50 (default 20); total capped at 10,000.
features.notable: Theme and CTA are normalized enums, so angle browsing works across brands.

features.feature: Impression rank, reach and trend signals
features.detail: Top-performing is judged by public-data proxies: impression_rank and percentile (current or all_time), impression_trend rising/stable/falling (Meta only), rank and percentile deltas over 1d/7d/14d/30d/60d/90d, total and period reach with pct change, reached countries, days_running, creative_duplicates. Sort orders: newest, oldest, most_active, best_match, recently_ended, most_impressions, most_reach, most_saved.
features.limits_or_cost: No spend estimate or engagement field in the API.
features.notable: Rising-rank filter finds ads gaining momentum now, not just long-runners; most_saved uses community saves as a signal.

features.feature: Brand library search with web traffic
features.detail: Search brands by name, host, advertiser name or ad copy; filter by industries, monthly traffic, traffic growth %, countries, active ads, new ads in a 1-90 day window, socials. Sort by traffic, traffic_growth, total_ads, active_ads, new_ads, new_ads_growth. Brand rows return logo, hosts, socials with follower counts, 12-month traffic series, ad counts (total, active, last 30 days vs prior 30), media_mix and last_scraped_at.
features.limits_or_cost: limit 1-100; followed list paging capped at 1000.
features.notable: Sorting brands by new_ads_growth surfaces who is ramping up testing.

features.detail: Adds a Save to Atria button on Meta and TikTok ad libraries; toolbar icon also browses library ads. Saved ads stored in cloud boards and sub-boards, tagged and filterable; video ads auto-transcribed; AI analysis of testimonials and scripts.
features.limits_or_cost: About 4,000 users, 4.6/5 from 9 ratings, v1.2.5 (Oct 2026). Turn off ad blocker.

features.detail: Saved ads carry saved_at, board ids and workspace tags. Boards nest (parent_id). Saved list sorts saved_newest (default) or saved_oldest and filters by board and tag plus all library filters.

Pick a competitor ad or winning creative; Atria adapts it to your brand. Inputs: the reference ad, your website URL (Atria pulls imagery and copy) or uploaded product photos, a saved brand profile (colors, fonts, messaging). Output: eight on-brand variants in seconds; keeps product texture and character or object consistency across edits; can also generate from per-ad AI recommendations.
features.limits_or_cost: Uses AI credits (per-image cost unverified). One Trustpilot user reported the clone altered product looks.
features.notable: Closest direct analogue to 'find proven content, then Remix it into your brand'.

features.detail: Inputs: prompt (a creative brief up to 10,000 chars, expanded by Atria into concepts), brand_id (owned brand), aspect_ratio auto_closest_fit, 1:1 (default), 4:5, 9:16, size 1-20 concept variants (default 1), optional reference_image_url (for remixing a reference), language (default English), logo_url, product_image_urls, colors (default brand colors). Async: returns generation_id and status pending/processing/success/partial_success/failed; poll then fetch images.
features.limits_or_cost: Credits reserved on submit and multiplied by size; failed images refunded automatically. Brand over plan limit cannot be used (40301).
features.notable: Reference image plus brand kit plus N variants in one call is the remix primitive.

features.detail: Workspace brand profiles hold name, industries, logo, website, colors and fonts; used as defaults by generation and briefs.
features.limits_or_cost: Core 3, Plus 8, Business and Enterprise unlimited.

features.feature: AI scripts, concepts, review mining and URL briefs
features.detail: Writes ad scripts from competitor URLs or customer reviews; mines Trustpilot reviews for customer language; AI URL analysis creates ad or brand briefs; turns a viral ad into a scene-by-scene brief for a UGC creator; generates concepts and ad copy.
features.limits_or_cost: Uses AI credits (4,000/10,000/25,000 per month by plan).
features.notable: Review mining supplies real customer phrasing for hooks.

features.detail: Library and extension-saved video ads are transcribed; for connected ad accounts an endpoint returns a cached transcript or creates one on demand. Marketing claims it explains why the 3-second hook worked.
features.limits_or_cost: Creating a transcript is slow and uses credits.

features.detail: Setup: open the Raya tab in Slack, click setup, choose channels and invite her (later /invite @Raya). Mention her in channel. Examples: review rivals' recent ads for bold claims, offers and repeated messaging and recommend what to respond to or test; compare last week's Meta ad performance by angle and suggest three new angles; weekly recap of wins, drops, budget opportunities, next actions. Marketed as reading brand, ads and data to find winning personas, hooks and key messages, building briefs, and turning winning formulas into new ads.
features.limits_or_cost: One Slack workspace per Atria workspace. Credit use unverified.
features.notable: Agent lives where the team already talks; proactive competitor watch plus angle suggestions.

features.detail: On connected ad accounts, grades each ad with a letter (examples A, B-, C+) in plain English, flags underperformers and gives a specific fix (e.g. open with the pain point, add a price anchor, rewrite a statement hook as a question). An Iterate button generates new script variations or image assets from the recommendation.
features.limits_or_cost: Radar on all plans. Exact metrics and scale unverified (third parties cite CTR, hook rate, retention, ROAS).
features.notable: Grade -> prescription -> one-click iterate closes the loop from analysis to new creative.

features.feature: Own ad account analytics and batch launch
features.detail: Connect Meta and TikTok ad accounts; dashboards show CTR trends, ROAS by creative angle and fatigue signals; visual reports; account summary, ads and metrics via API. Batch Launch pushes many creative variants to Meta in one click and can scale winners and pause losers. Naming convention setting on Plus.
features.limits_or_cost: Ad accounts 5/10/unlimited; ad spend analyzed $500K/$1M/unlimited per month.

features.detail: Endpoint https://api.tryatria.com/mcp, Streamable HTTP, OAuth sign-in (no API key). Claude: Customize > Connectors > + > Add custom connector. ChatGPT Business/Enterprise/Edu via developer mode or app directory. Tools: search ad and brand libraries, read boards and ad accounts, transcribe videos, generate images. Verify with 'List my Atria ad accounts'. Documented prompts render a competitor thumbnail wall with hooks and CTAs, board theme clusters, Black Friday theme scan, account KPI report.
features.limits_or_cost: Core 600 calls/mo; unlimited on Plus and up.
features.notable: Docs tell users to ask for an Artifact or HTML report, not raw JSON.

features.detail: Base https://api.tryatria.com/open/v1, X-API-Key header (keys start atria-sk_, max 2 active per workspace, shown once). Groups: Inspo Brands, Advertisers, Ad Library, Owned Brands, Image Generations, Ad Accounts, Boards. Envelope code/message/data; validation errors return HTTP 200 with code 40001; 402 billing, 403 plan lacks API, 429 with Retry-After.
features.limits_or_cost: Core 1,200 calls/mo; unlimited on Plus and up.

features.detail: Documented cron: list followed brands, query ads launched_after the cutoff per brand sorted newest, dedupe by ad id, print brand, ad id, title, start date, and list locked brands. Advises overlapping windows because launch date is not discovery date, and persisting emitted ids to avoid repeat alerts.
features.limits_or_cost: Followed brand list paging capped at 1000.
features.notable: Launch-date vs discovery-date caveat matters for any 'new competitor posts' alert.

features.detail: Core, Plus, Business, Enterprise; Pay monthly or Pay annually (Save 20%). Credits power AI generation, transcription and analysis. Free start with 1,000 credits, no card.
features.limits_or_cost: Annual $129/$479/$959 per month; monthly $159/$599/$1,199 (third party); +$20/seat; Enterprise custom.
features.notable: Single credit currency across AI features.

features.detail: Comparison table lists Demo mode, Invite members, Invite guests and Ad account access control. Invite guests explicitly on Business.
features.limits_or_cost: Per-plan checkmarks for other rows unverified.

features.detail: Install, pin, open extension and click Connect to link the workspace. On Facebook Ad Library and TikTok Ad Library click the purple Save Ad button; on TikTok Creative Center click See Analytics then Save Ad. Saves to My Ads by default or a chosen board; ads kept after they stop running.
features.limits_or_cost: Rated 3.1/5 (10 ratings), about 4,000 users (Nov 2025).

features.feature: Discover library with Explore and For You feeds
features.detail: 12M+ ads from 250,000+ brands, new content hourly; AI performance estimates filter out spam and low-quality ads. Explore: randomised, constantly updated stream. For You: creative from brands you follow plus a 14-day digest. Filters button (top right) including custom tags; eye button toggles ad copy, headline and CTA, and run time vs performance estimate. Save to board via down button; link icon makes a share link. AdManage cites a curated Discover Library of 100,000 ads.
features.notable: Feed defaults to quality-filtered ads, so browsing starts from likely winners.

features.feature: AI Smart Search by copy, image or transcript
features.detail: Search brands, industries or themes. Per search term choose to search ad copy, images or verbal transcripts, or leave default and let AI pick the most relevant.
features.notable: Lets a user find ads by what is said on camera, not just caption text.

features.feature: Performance Estimate bars on public ads
features.detail: MagicAI scores each library ad 1-4 bars from 60+ attributes of high-performing creative (e.g. script quality, editing pace, ad longevity) using public data only. 4 bars = most likely a winner; grey bars = awaiting scoring. Shown in the feed (toggle via eye icon) and in the ad detail right sidebar.
features.limits_or_cost: Estimates only, not account data.
features.notable: Coarse 4-level score is honest about uncertainty and easy to scan.

features.detail: Search a brand; if missing click Expand Search to add it. Ingest takes about 20-30 minutes and shows processing. Tracked view: 14-day creative overview (new ads, landing pages, output trend, media mix), Hooks (opening seconds or lines most tested), ad copy and headlines, landing pages, media mix split. Source: public ad libraries. History starts the day added; first day captures only ads live that day.
features.limits_or_cost: Unlimited tracked brands on Creative Intelligence plan; other caps unverified.
features.notable: Explicit warning that the first-day spike is an artifact; honest about history gaps.

features.feature: Ad boards with sub-boards and public or private links
features.detail: Inspire sidebar [+] creates a board; open a board > + New, or hover the sidebar name, to make sub-boards (nested dropdown). Hover > [...] to share, move, rename. Share as private link (team only) or public link (anyone, no account). Filter boards search at the bottom of the sidebar. Suggested structures: by concept or theme, client or vertical, product range.

Four 1-100 scores on own ads: Hook Score (first 1-3s, video), Hold Score (4s to end, video), Click Score (offer, copy, script, overlays), Buy Score (landing page, packaging, checkout, AOV). Bands: above 70 green strong, 50-70 yellow, below 50 red needs attention. Add via metrics modal search 'Wizard Scores'.
features.limits_or_cost: Ad needs more than $50 spend to be scored.
features.notable: Funnel-stage scores tell the user which part of the creative to fix.

features.detail: Copilot Settings: spend benchmark (recommended at least $250), performance goal (ROAS, CPA, CTR), New window (e.g. 7 or 14 days), optional filters or tags, visible KPIs. Ads sorted into New, Scaling (above spend threshold), Winners (scaling and meeting goal), Opportunities (spent but underperformed, iterate or cut). Smart Badges mark scaling, winning, needs attention.
features.notable: Four buckets turn a metrics table into a to-do list.

features.detail: Overview reports for individual ads or elements; Comparison reports measure custom ad groups against target metrics. Defaults: Top Creatives, Static Breakdown, Video Breakdown, Top Copy, Top Landing Page, Top Hooks, Compare Formats. Chart View or Card View; Group By Ad Name or Copy (merges 9x16 and 1x1 versions); ad breakdown per group; fixed or rolling dates; Save Report / Save As; share as private or public link. CSV export of Overview reports.
features.notable: Top Hooks report as a default makes hooks a first-class unit of analysis.

features.detail: Full-screen ad view in Insights > Tags section in right sidebar > add or create tags > save. Tags work as report filters, comparison groups (tagged) and Group-By, e.g. creator, offer, theme.

Ad Account Settings > Automatic Tagging. Delimited Ad Names to Tags: set column count, delimiter (_, |, -), map each column to a tag category, Skip ID columns, preview Valid Only, save (e.g. UGC_Merlin_TOFU_Quality -> Concept, Creator, Funnel, Angle). Phrase to Tags: + Add Phrase, choose category and tag, preview Matches Only. Optional custom capture boundaries to avoid partial matches.
features.notable: Turns existing naming conventions into analyzable angle and creator tags without manual work.

features.detail: Workspace settings > Guest Users tab > magic invite link; guest signs up to an empty view; then Insights > ad account > Ad Account Settings > Manage Guest Users > add. Guests see only assigned ad accounts.
SlackBot posts automated report summaries with ad performance updates into Slack. Ad account integrations: Meta and TikTok (help docs); AdManage also lists YouTube and LinkedIn sync.
features.limits_or_cost: Frequency options unverified.

features.detail: Brief templates for creative teams and creators, with client approvals and revision flows per third-party reviews. Exact modules, AI generation and statuses unverified (help articles are video-only).
features.limits_or_cost: Included in Pro per AdManage.

features.detail: MagicBrief closed 31 July 2026 8 PM EST after Canva acquired it (announced Cannes Lions 2025). Inspire collections had no bulk export. Successor Canva Grow: paste a website link and product visuals to generate editable ads, Brand Kit (Pro), publish to Meta, TikTok or LinkedIn from Canva, analytics dashboard with Learn view, Active Ads view and AI ad tagging with recommendations.
features.limits_or_cost: Canva Grow: free accounts limited AI ad generation; ad insights only on Business and Enterprise with creative-count limits.
features.notable: Inspiration library did not survive the move; Canva kept generation, publishing and analytics.

features.detail: Left sidebar photo icon > Inspo > Discover. A feed of curated ads from 600+ brands in 30+ industries, pulled from Meta's Ad Library. A toggle at the top switches between 'For you' and 'Following'. Filters: Industry, Visual format, Type (image, video, carousel), Days active, Product type. A 'Saved' toggle at the top of Discover shows the workspace's saved ads. Inspo is workspace-level: each workspace has its own boards, saved ads and followed brands.
features.limits_or_cost: Needs an active paid subscription; not on expired trials or free accounts.
features.notable: Help docs suggest filtering by your own product type or industry to see the ads your customers are being served.

features.detail: A strip at the top of Discover titled 'Formats you haven't tried'. It compares the visual formats in the curated library against the formats in the user's connected Meta ad account and surfaces example ads in formats the user has not run yet.
features.limits_or_cost: Needs a connected Meta ad account.
features.notable: A gap-finder against the user's own history. Content Studio could do the same against an adviser's past posts: 'carousel myth-busters you have never posted'.

features.detail: Inspo > Trending ranks the most saved ads and most followed brands across all Motion users over the last 7 days, filterable by industry. A public page (motionapp.com/trending) titled 'Top ads this week' updates weekly, ranks by 'community saves', and lets visitors browse 31 industry categories; some cards show post age such as '22d'. Spend and format filters, the full feed and saving need a free sign-up.
features.notable: Ranks by what other customers saved, not by ad metrics, so it works without performance data. A public SEO page drives sign-ups.

features.feature: Follow a brand / Add a missing brand
features.detail: Search a brand in the Discover search bar, open its profile, click 'Follow'. New ads from followed brands appear under the 'Following' feed. If the brand is not in Motion, scroll down, choose 'Add a missing brand' and paste the brand's Facebook page or Meta Ads Library link. Brand pages show a 'more brands like this one' dropdown.
features.limits_or_cost: unverified
features.notable: Adding a brand only needs a pasted Facebook page or Ad Library URL, nothing else.

features.detail: Reached from Following > 'all brands', or from a single brand page. Each brand card shows media mix (active ad count and ad types), visual formats as percentages, and landing pages as percentages. Filter by industry at the top.
features.notable: Turns a competitor's ad library into a one-card summary of what formats they lean on.

features.detail: Saved view sorts by latest saves (oldest or newest) and filters by Visual format, Type, Days active, Brand, Status (active or inactive), Ad length (e.g. 0-15 sec), Partnership vs branded ads, and Saved by (user).
features.notable: 'Saved by' filter and 'Partnership vs branded' are useful team and creator-content cuts.

features.detail: Save with the bookmark icon on any card (Discover, Trending, brand page) or by double-clicking an ad and choosing 'Save'. In the ad detail view, 'Add to Board' lets you pick or create a board. 'Create Board' in the sidebar needs a name; description is optional. Boards group into Folders (help docs suggest by type, messaging angle or awareness stage). Sidebar search finds boards and folders; drag and drop reorders them. Saving shares the ad with the whole organization.
features.limits_or_cost: Only Account Owners, Admins and Collaborators can change Inspo; Guests view shared boards by link only.
features.notable: Folders by awareness stage maps well to adviser content (unaware, problem-aware, product-aware).

features.detail: 'Share board' has three paths: tick linked workspaces (or share with all current and future workspaces); 'Copy link' tab for teammates; 'External partners' tab > 'Add a new partner' > email > choose boards > 'Send invitation'. Partners get read-only access and can view, save to their own workspace, or duplicate (duplicates are independent copies). Shared boards land in 'Shared with me'; owners manage access in Workspace Settings > Shared Boards.
features.notable: Read-only partner invite plus 'duplicate into my workspace' is a clean way for an agency or team lead to hand swipe files to advisers.

features.feature: Comments and transcript on Inspo ads
features.detail: Users can comment directly on an Inspo ad. Opening a video ad shows a 'Transcript' tab with the spoken script.
features.notable: Transcript next to the video is the raw input a remix step needs.

features.detail: Inspo > Organic is a recommended feed of trending organic content and creators drawn from the TikTok library. TikTok content currently appears only here; a TikTok ad integration is in progress.
features.notable: Ad-intel tools are adding organic feeds, which is Content Studio's lane.

features.feature: AI thought starters on a brand page
features.detail: On a followed brand's page the user picks a thought starter such as 'analyze their messaging approach'. The task runs in AI Chat and the result is kept in AI Chat history. AI Chat elsewhere in Motion can also reference followed brands.
features.limits_or_cost: AI Chat runs on Runneth; Guests cannot use it.
features.notable: Preset one-click prompts on a competitor page remove the blank-prompt problem.

features.detail: Free Chrome extension (v1.3.1, updated Feb 3, 2026) that adds a 'Save to Motion' button on ads in Meta's Ad Library, TikTok's Ad Library and TikTok Creative Center. A dropdown on the button picks the target board. Saved ads are shared with the whole organization.
features.limits_or_cost: Free; Chrome only.

features.detail: The Motion iPhone app adds Motion to the iOS share sheet, so a user can save a post from Instagram or TikTok while scrolling. Saved items sync to Motion on web.
features.notable: Capture from the phone while scrolling is how advisers actually find content; worth copying for Content Studio.

features.detail: Auto-tags the user's own Meta creatives. Groups: Visual ('Asset type' e.g. UGC, lifestyle image, high production; 'Visual format' e.g. listicle, founder story, skit, podcast), Persona ('Intended audience' e.g. moms of tweens), Messaging ('Messaging theme', 'Seasonality' e.g. Black Friday, 'Offer type' e.g. promo, evergreen), Hook ('Hook / Headline tactic' e.g. question, callout, contrarian, bold claim, confession, if/then). Marketed as 8 categories. To edit: click thumbnail > 'Creative insights' > change tags; edits apply to that creative everywhere. Tags show in English but work on creatives in many languages.
features.limits_or_cost: Meta only. Creatives with spend in the last 90 days plus new ones, processed daily; first tags in 24-36 hours; new accounts need 10+ creatives launched in 90 days. Included on trial.
features.notable: Taxonomy (format, hook tactic, theme, offer, persona, season) is a ready-made schema for tagging adviser posts.

features.detail: In a Comparative analysis report, the 'Group by' dropdown can pick any AI tag. After tagging finishes, Motion drops eight ready-made reports into an 'AI Tag Comparisons' folder. In a 'Top Performing' report, 'AI tags' next to the metrics adds tag columns to Card and Table views.
features.notable: Pre-built reports appear on their own after setup, so the user gets value without building anything.

features.detail: Home page leaderboard of 'your top 10 ads of the week' from new launches and existing assets, with an up or down marker against the prior week. Paired with 'Weekly performance trends' and AI suggestions to turn near-winners into winners.
features.limits_or_cost: All paid plans and the trial.
features.notable: Rank movement week over week makes a static list feel alive.

features.detail: Home page section that tracks ads scaling or declining week over week, based on spend, and flags recently launched ads.

'Create report' > 'Top performing report' or Comparative analysis. Filter by naming conventions, 200+ metrics, custom conversions and Northbeam data. Comparative reports group by format, hook tactic, message, audience, talent type, or agency vs in-house. 'Winning Combinations' measures results across creative variables; 'Launch Analysis' tracks new launches.
features.limits_or_cost: Meta has every feature; TikTok has metrics and creative insights; LinkedIn and YouTube get Top Performing and Comparative only.

features.detail: Card view shows the video thumbnail with four video play rate metrics below it: 25%, 50%, 75% and 100%. Setup: 'Create report' > 'Top performing report' > 'Add filter' > 'Ad setup > Ad type is video'. To compare like lengths, add time buckets (0-15s, 15-30s, 30-60s, 60-120s) to ad names and filter with 'Ad name contains'. Guidance: a big drop between milestones means a buried message; strong 75% with weak 100% means move the CTA earlier.
features.notable: Plain-language rules for reading a retention curve could be copied into post analytics.

features.detail: Share a report or AI task output as a frozen or live Snapshot that viewers can open without platform access. Option to hide sensitive data for freelancers and agencies.

Each Starter account gets its own always-on 'Runneth AI brain' on a dedicated VM. It pre-watches, tags and analyzes every creative the account has run. Users ask it in Slack; it ships briefs, hooks and reports. 'Routines' run daily and weekly reports, iteration finders and alerts. Includes Inspo, benchmarks, full data and MCP access. Pro adds first-pass video QA in Slack.
features.limits_or_cost: Starter $999/mo (up to $50k spend).
features.notable: Moves from dashboard to scheduled agent that posts into the chat tool the team already uses.

features.detail: AI tasks: 'Give me feedback before launch' reviews an uploaded ad before it runs to catch likely flops; 'Track ads launched by competitors' finds rivals' latest ads and builds a plan to respond; 'Analyze this report' runs a one-click weekly retro of what to keep and cut. Outputs are kept in an Inbox and allow follow-up questions.
features.notable: Pre-publish critique is a direct fit for adviser posts (also a natural place for a compliance check).

features.detail: Searchable library of 22M+ Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ads, updated daily. Filters per a 2026 review: performance tier, estimated spend range ($0-$500 up to $20,000+), days running, landing page type (product page, listicle, advertorial, quiz), landing page technology (e.g. Shopify), format (video, image, carousel), CTA, country, language, age, gender. Ad cards show a runtime badge such as '30d'. Trend card fields: Top hook, Top format, Top angle.
features.limits_or_cost: Browsing and searching are free; no credits used. Meta only (site copy elsewhere claims TikTok and Google, but its FAQ says Meta focus).
features.notable: Landing page type as a filter (listicle, advertorial, quiz) is a rare and useful cut.

features.detail: Each ad gets 1 to 5 stars from run length, creative reuse, brand activity and impressions, as a proxy because competitor ROAS, CTR and spend are hidden. A review describes the tiers as testing up to winning, with the top tiers needing at least 7 and 14 days of run time.
features.limits_or_cost: Spend and reach are estimates.
features.notable: A simple stars score built from public signals (days running, how many variants reuse the creative) is the core 'proven' signal for any swipe tool.

features.detail: Paste a rival's Meta Ad Library URL or pick from 20,000 pre-tracked brands. The brand joins one dashboard; every new ad it launches appears in the feed with its launch date and the count of ads live now. Report shows format breakdown, daily active ad counts, most-used hooks, top landing pages and trends over time. New ads are logged automatically with a running history.
features.limits_or_cost: 2 credits per Brand Spy (per review).
features.notable: Daily active-ad count over time is a simple 'are they scaling' chart.

features.detail: One-click save to 'Boards'. Saved ads are visible to the whole team, sit in unlimited custom folders by project, client or concept, and accept strategic notes. Saved ads stay available after the advertiser stops them and they leave Meta's library.
features.limits_or_cost: Team sharing from Pro (3 seats) up to Agency (10 seats).
features.notable: Permanent copy of ads that disappear from Meta is a key reason people pay for swipe tools.

features.detail: Free extension. Open Facebook's Ad Library, save an ad, and the brand plus all its ads get pulled into Gethookd and become searchable for everyone. Also saves TikTok ads into boards.
features.limits_or_cost: Free.
features.notable: Each user save grows the shared database, so coverage of niche markets (like Singapore advisers) fills itself in.

features.detail: Select a winning ad (or upload a competitor's or your own) and click Clone. AI keeps the proven structure and swaps colors, avatars, formats, styles and dimensions (square, portrait, landscape for Facebook and Instagram placements), pulling brand images and product details from the active brand profile. Home page example: three new static ads from one creative. Outputs are editable.
features.limits_or_cost: Spends credits ('AI Image Ads'); per-clone cost not published. Home page says Clone starts on Pro; the AI ad generator page lists it on all plans (conflict).
features.notable: Remix keeps the structure and swaps in your brand automatically; this is the exact Content Studio 'Remix into your brand' pattern.

features.detail: Profiles store brand images, product details and creative guidelines, one per client or product line. Products created in a profile are used automatically during Clone and script generation, so nothing is re-entered.
features.limits_or_cost: unverified

features.detail: Upload a winning ad and add product info; AI generates hooks, angles and full scripts. Hooks, body copy and CTAs can be refined after generation.
features.limits_or_cost: Spends credits ('AI Scripts'); cost per run not published. Listed on every plan.

features.detail: Transcribes a video ad to text and extracts its hook and CTA structure, as input for writing your own copy.
features.limits_or_cost: Spends credits ('Transcriptions'); cost not published.

features.detail: Breaks an ad into hook, angle and format; flags recurring hooks and formats across saved ads; applies the same performance scoring to the user's own creatives.
features.limits_or_cost: Spends credits; cost not published.

features.detail: Search Shopify stores by keyword; filters 'Traffic growth leaders', '50K+ monthly traffic', 'New shops'. Store page shows monthly traffic, traffic by country, Meta ads (active and launched), Trustpilot rating and 'Best sellers', with similar stores linked. Updated daily.
features.limits_or_cost: Shopify only.

features.detail: Hosted MCP at app.gethookd.ai/api/mcp/v1 with an API token; works in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and others. Tools include search_ads, get_ad, search_brands, get_brand, get_top_ads, list_brand_spies, get_brand_spy, plus boards, swipe file, saved searches and clone-ads. get_brand returns hook scores; list_brand_spies flags brands with new creative since last check. Example prompt: 'Which brands in my swipe file added new ads this week?'
features.limits_or_cost: Search tools spend credits at REST API rates (about 0.01 credits per ad); lookup tools are free; responses return used_credits and remaining_credits; sliding-window rate limit returns HTTP 429. Annual plans or monthly Team and Agency.
features.notable: Returning credit balance on every response is a clean metering pattern.

features.detail: One credit pool per plan (50/150/400/800 a month) covers Brand Spy, Transcriptions, AI Scripts, AI Image Ads and Creative Analyzer. Library browsing is free. Credits reset each billing cycle and more can be bought any time.
features.limits_or_cost: Starter's 50 credits run out fast with heavy Brand Spy and AI use (review).
features.notable: Free browse, paid actions: the library acts as the free hook, AI actions are the meter.

features.detail: Track any competitor in any country; plans include 'Request to track any competitor'. Channels: emails and newsletters, flows and sequences, SMS and WhatsApp, ads (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Google Display), landing pages, funnels, website changes and traffic, SEO, catalogs, prices, launches, promotions, reviews, tech stack, Instagram and organic social. Each brand page has tabs such as 'Landings' and 'Socials'. Data is 'samples of publicly available data'; collection method not stated.
features.limits_or_cost: Startup: up to 20 competitors and 6 months history; Professional and up: unlimited.
features.notable: Brand page with one tab per channel is a simple way to show everything one competitor publishes.

features.feature: Ads tracker with landing page link
features.detail: New ads are captured automatically so users do not check each ad library by hand. Full ad history including stopped ads. Each ad links to its landing page; you can see which other ads point to the same landing page. Ad search covers 2M+ ecommerce ads, filterable by industry, language, network, asset type and more.

Competitor newsletters, campaigns and SMS are tracked automatically and shown in a brand's SMS tab in chronological order, as if received on a phone. SMS search by keyword with industry and date filters. 'Remind me' can email a reminder in 1, 3 or 5 days. Method (seeded inboxes or numbers) not stated.
features.limits_or_cost: SMS, Landings and Flows search from Professional; Startup searches Emails and Ads only.

features.detail: Brand page 'Landings' tab or sidebar 'Landings Search' with keywords and filters. Captures homepages and product pages in desktop and mobile versions. 'Archives' gallery shows earlier detected versions; compare two versions side by side over a chosen period. 'Add to List' saves a page to a shareable list.
features.notable: Side-by-side version compare shows what a competitor changed and when.

features.detail: Breaks competitors' creatives down by format, hook, angle, topic, USP and offer to show what performs best.
features.limits_or_cost: unverified

features.detail: Calendar view of competitor campaigns organized by date, type and channel. Selecting a month gives a summary of campaign frequency, themes and types. Filter by campaign theme to spot seasonal patterns; 'Smart Content Search' across years (e.g. Black Friday). Alerts for specific competitors, campaign types or themes.
features.notable: Competitor posts plotted on a calendar map directly onto Content Studio's own calendar; e.g. show what rival advisers posted around Budget Day or CPF changes.

features.detail: 'Get Alerts & Summaries' with user-set rules. Daily and weekly AI summaries of competitor emails, ads and campaigns go to the dashboard and the inbox, with links to the source assets. Notifications fire when competitors launch new campaigns or change strategy.
features.limits_or_cost: Startup: 'Daily & Weekly Summaries'; Professional: 'Summaries, Alerts & Reports'.

features.feature: Ask AI and AI Insights Agents
features.detail: Ask any question about tracked competitors and the assistant answers. 'AI Insights Agents' run custom prompts across all tracked competitors' campaigns, plus ready-made agents that surface topics competitors cover that you do not, and suggest which emails and ads to create. Also reachable through Panoramata's MCP in Claude or ChatGPT.
features.limits_or_cost: MCP + Pano AI credits: 300 (Startup), 1,000 (Professional), 3,000 (Advanced). 'Ask AI, AI-Powered Insights & Media Generation' from Professional.
features.notable: 'Topics they cover that you don't' is a content-gap prompt Content Studio can run on rival advisers.

features.detail: Scores each tracked competitor on activity, volume and consistency, and ranks competitors in real time. Separate 'Email Scoring' feature.
features.notable: Consistency score maps well to organic posting cadence.

features.detail: 'Create lists of assets to refer to later' (examples: 'BFCM Inspiration', 'Competitors' product launches', 'GIFs'), shareable with the team or external collaborators. Pricing lists 'Unlimited Canvas Boards' and 'Save Assets in Boards & Swipe Files' from Professional.
features.limits_or_cost: Boards from Professional ($179/mo).

features.detail: 'Searches & Inspiration - Access 500M marketing assets' across emails, ads, SMS, flows and landing pages, with keyword and filters. Home page cites 100M+ assets and 80k+ brands across 80 countries (figures vary by page).
features.limits_or_cost: Startup: emails and ads only; Professional adds SMS, landings and flows.

features.detail: Real-time dashboards and benchmark reports (3/10/20 by plan), 'Compare Yourself' against competitors, industry benchmarks shareable with teams or clients, CSV export, 'Custom Reports Builder', 'Bulk Export Creatives' (Advanced), 'LLM AI Exports & Sync', 'AI Slack App' (Advanced).
features.limits_or_cost: Varies by plan; see pricing.

features.detail: Pick a location, then an ad category ('All Ads' or 'Issues, elections or politics' and other special categories), then type a keyword or advertiser name. Quotes force an exact phrase; '|' matches multiple words in any order. Also reachable from any Facebook Page: About > Page Transparency > See All > Go to Ad Library.
features.limits_or_cost: Free, no login for search.

features.detail: Language; Advertiser; Platforms (Facebook, Instagram, Audience Network, Messenger); Media type (images, memes, images and memes, videos, no image or video); Active status (active, inactive, both); 'Impressions by date' start and end. Political ads add Delivery by Region, Disclaimer and Estimated Audience Size.

Each card shows Library ID, Active or Inactive status, the date it started running, platforms, whether there are multiple versions and how many ads use the same creative and text, plus the caption, creative, CTA and landing page. 'See ad details' (or 'See summary details' for EU ads) opens more. No spend, impressions or clicks for commercial ads outside the EU.
features.notable: Start date and the count of ads reusing a creative are the two public 'proven' signals every swipe tool builds on.

features.detail: For ads delivered in the EU: targeting location, age and gender; total reach broken down by country, age and gender; 'About the advertiser'; 'Beneficiary and payer'. Inactive EU ads stay archived for one year after last impression.
features.limits_or_cost: EU and UK delivery only.

features.detail: Issues, elections or politics ads show Library ID, status, start date, platforms, categories, Estimated Audience Size, Amount spent and Impressions; details include 'About the disclaimer' (who paid), 'Ad audience', 'Ad delivery', age, gender and location breakdowns. Kept for 7 years whether active or not.

'Branded content' link in the top nav. Choose Facebook or Instagram, a date range, and a business or creator name; results show the brand partner, post type and 'See post' link to the original post. Covers paid-partnership posts live on or after Aug 17, 2023; excludes affiliate posts and giveaways.
features.notable: A public source of organic creator posts tagged as paid partnerships, closer to organic than ads.

features.detail: 'Save search' with a name; re-run later from 'Saved searches'. You cannot save individual ads or add labels.
features.limits_or_cost: Needs a Facebook login.
features.notable: No per-ad save is the gap every swipe-file tool fills.

features.detail: Graph API ads_archive. Params: ad_type (ALL, EMPLOYMENT_ADS, FINANCIAL_PRODUCTS_AND_SERVICES_ADS, HOUSING_ADS, POLITICAL_AND_ISSUE_ADS), ad_reached_countries, ad_active_status (default ACTIVE), ad_delivery_date_min/max, search_terms (max 100 chars), search_type (KEYWORD_UNORDERED default, KEYWORD_EXACT_PHRASE), search_page_ids (up to 10), languages, media_type (ALL, IMAGE, MEME, VIDEO, NONE), publisher_platforms (incl. THREADS, WHATSAPP). Fields for all ads: id, ad_creation_time, ad_creative_bodies, link titles, captions and descriptions, ad_delivery_start_time and stop_time, ad_snapshot_url, languages, page_id, page_name, publisher_platforms. EU-only: eu_total_reach, beneficiary_payers, age_country_gender_reach_breakdown, target_ages, target_gender, target_locations. Political-only: spend, impressions, currency, bylines, demographic_distribution, delivery_by_region, estimated_audience_size.
features.limits_or_cost: Free for authorized users. Ads that never reached an EU location are returned only if they are political or issue ads, so Singapore commercial ads are not in the API.
features.notable: Singapore commercial ads cannot be pulled through the API; SG coverage needs the web library, a scraper, or user saves.

features.detail: Aggregated, downloadable view of social issue, election or political ads in one country over a chosen period: disclaimer, amount spent and number of ads by advertiser, with CSV download by date range.
features.limits_or_cost: Only countries that require authorization to run political ads.

features.feature: Top Ads Dashboard filters and sort
features.detail: Inspiration > Top Ads. Filters: Region (one or more of 28 countries, default your location), Industry (21 groups with sub-industries), Objective (Traffic, App Installs, Conversions, Video Views, Reach, Lead Generation, Product sales), Period (last 7, 30 or 180 days), Ad Language, Ad Format (Spark Ads or Non-Spark Ads), Likes band (e.g. 'Top 1~20%'). Sort by For You, Reach, CTR, or Others (2s Views Rate, 6s Views Rate, CVR, Likes). Search by brand or keyword. 'Link' shares an ad; 'Star' favorites it.
features.limits_or_cost: Free. Only ads authorized by advertisers in TikTok Ads Manager and above performance thresholds; watermarked, not downloadable.
features.notable: 6s Views Rate sort works as a hook score.

features.feature: Top Ads card and detail metrics
features.detail: Cards show Likes, CTR as a percentile ('Top N%' vs same-industry ads, not a raw rate) and Budget level (Low, Medium, High). Detail page ('See analytics') adds Region, Industry, Objective, Brand name, Landing page, Ad caption, Likes, Comments, Shares. Never shows spend, impressions, reach, targeting, dates or run length.
features.notable: Percentile bands instead of raw numbers let a platform share performance without exposing advertiser data.

features.detail: On a Top Ad detail page, a second-by-second, frame-by-frame graph with tabs CTR, CVR, Clicks, Conversion and Remain (retention), indexed 0-100, plotted against the industry average with the video's rank. Spikes are marked as 'highlight frames' so you can jump to the moment that drove clicks or drop-off.
features.limits_or_cost: Login required.
features.notable: Marking the exact second that drove clicks or drop-off on a proven video tells the user what to keep when remixing.

features.detail: Table of keywords used in TikTok ads. Filters: search, region, industry, objective, keyword type, time. Columns: Popularity (videos using the keyword and related keywords), Popularity change, CTR, CVR, CPA, Cost, Impressions, 6s View Rate, Likes, Shares, Comments. Shows how the keyword is used (voice-over, text overlay, ad text).
features.limits_or_cost: From paid ads only, not organic; desktop only (per third-party guide); possibly login-only or retired (Moda could not find it signed out).
features.notable: Keyword-level CTR/CVR is a way to rank phrases for hooks.

features.detail: Products ranked by how often ads feature them. Filters: region, product category, period (last day, 7 days, 30 days). Metrics include impressions, view-through rate, comments, likes. 'Details' view shows CTR, CPA, an impressions chart, audience age breakdown, related videos and hashtags.
features.limits_or_cost: unverified whether still live (Moda: treat as login-only or gone).

features.detail: Trends > Hashtags ranked by number of posts and interest over time; search or filter by industry and time frame. 'See Analytics' opens the trendline, related videos, audience insights, regional popularity, related interests and related hashtags.
features.limits_or_cost: Signed out: top 3 only.

features.detail: Trends > Songs with 'Popular' and 'Breakout' tabs. Filter by time frame, 'New to Top 100', and 'Approved for business use' (royalty-free for brands). Detail view has the same insights as hashtags.
features.notable: 'Approved for business use' filter matters for any brand account; advisers posting as businesses would need it.

features.detail: Creators: filter by audience region and follower count; shows top videos; 'Connect via TikTok Creator Marketplace'. Only Creator Marketplace members above engagement, posting and follower thresholds are listed. TikTok Videos: pick a period and sort by hot, likes, comments or shares.
Groups trends into three waves: Trend Moments (short-term), Trend Signals and Trend Forces (long-term).
features.notable: A short vs long trend split helps decide what to post this week vs build a series on.

features.detail: 'Creative Patterns' filtered by Games or E-commerce, ranked by CTR, view-through rate, ad spend and ad spend change. 'Best Practices' cards each show their data source and context, e.g. native ads over repurposed ads, citing 27% higher completion rate.
features.limits_or_cost: Games and e-commerce only.
features.notable: Each tip cites its data, which builds trust.

features.detail: Inputs: industry, product name, product description. 'Advanced Settings': video format, keywords, video duration. Output: ad scripts.
features.limits_or_cost: Free with login.

features.detail: Symphony is TikTok's generative AI suite (Creative Studio, Ads Manager, brainstorming), opened from an icon top right. The assistant produces creative analysis reports, TikTok insights, ad scripts and creative ideas. 'Video Generator' offers templates with transitions, text, effects, stickers and music plus add-ons (Shake Surprise, Pop-ups, Multi-video screen).
features.limits_or_cost: Login required; free.

features.detail: Signed out: four Top Ads cards then 'View More' and 'Log in to access all Top Ads and more'; Trends shows only the first 3 hashtags.
features.notable: A small free preview, then a login wall, used as a sign-up hook.

features.detail: Search an advertiser or domain (guide recommends the domain). Filters: date range (Anytime, Today, Yesterday, Last 7 Days, Last 30 Days, custom), country or region shown, format (All, Image, Text, Video), topic (All Topics or Political Ads). Default sort is most recently served. 'See All Ads' loads the full grid. Covers Search, Display and YouTube.
features.limits_or_cost: Free. Verified advertisers only; ads appear 48-72 hours after going live.

features.detail: Clicking an ad shows when it was last shown, its format, regions shown, and the advertiser's legal name and verified country. Text search ads render as image previews. Also reachable from the three-dot menu next to a live ad.
features.limits_or_cost: No spend or impressions for commercial ads.

features.detail: linkedin.com/ad-library. Search by company or advertiser, payer, keyword (matches ad text), one or more countries, and date range (custom via URL params keyword, countries, dateOption=custom-date-range, startdate, enddate). 'More' adds impressions range and targeting filters. Results sort newest first only.
features.limits_or_cost: Free. About 24-25 results per query; no save, export or API; bot protection blocks fast browsing.

features.detail: All ads: preview (intro text, creative, headline, CTA), format (Single Image, Video, Document, Carousel, event, Thought Leader ads), advertiser and payer. EU-targeted ads only: run start and end dates, impressions band (under 1k, 1k-5k, 5k-10k, 10k-20k up to 500k-1M), impressions by country to the nearest percent, and 12 targeting categories each marked included or excluded. Ads stay searchable one year after last impression; coverage from June 1, 2023.
features.limits_or_cost: Never shows spend, clicks or exact impressions. Impression and targeting filters do nothing for non-EU searches.
features.notable: Thought Leader ads are promoted member posts, the closest to adviser-style organic content in any ad library.

features.detail: Search ads across Meta (Facebook), TikTok and Pinterest from one place. Homepage claims 80M+ active ads and 120k+ daily ad and shop updates; dropship-spy page claims 900M+ indexed ads. Section label: Discover All Performing Ads, filter by spend, activity and more.
features.limits_or_cost: TikTok and Pinterest Ads Library on Premium in the credit-era plans; Meta ads listing on Starter.
features.notable: Ad running time is treated as the profitability signal, not just likes.

features.detail: Search by keyword, domain name, date created and viewed, social engagement, target audience, country and language. Review lists keyword or niche, platform, date, country, ad format, page name, domain and engagement. Facebook can be filtered by 15 engagement types including love and anger reactions. URL default sort seen: sort_by=-creation_date (newest first).
features.limits_or_cost: Ad spend filters on Starter per a competitor review (unverified).
features.notable: Filtering by emotional reaction type (anger, love) as a proxy for strong response.

features.detail: Ranked list of the Top 100 Trending Products, refreshed every 8 hours. A competitor review says it scores products on 25 metrics every 3 hours (engagement, market saturation, seasonality, competitor density) and treats a score above 85 as strong validation; that scoring detail is unverified by Minea.
features.limits_or_cost: Business plan only.
features.notable: A single composite score with a stated threshold turns raw metrics into a yes/no 'proven' signal.

features.detail: Tracks product placements by influencers, including sponsored posts that are not paid ads, so users can see which creators push which products and pick a suitable influencer.
features.limits_or_cost: unverified
features.notable: Indexes organic sponsored posts, not only ad libraries. Closest analogue to tracking organic posts by other advisers.

features.detail: Homepage section One Screenshot to Endless Creatives: snap or upload a screenshot and see all ads and creatives related to that product. Magic Search also accepts a product name or image and shows how widely the product is sold and on which platforms. Copyfy describes it as natural-language search.
features.limits_or_cost: Starter and up (credit-era plan list).
features.notable: Image in, matching ads out: lets a user start from something they saw on their own feed.

features.detail: Per-ad AI analysis listed as a metered feature on the pricing page. What the analysis outputs (hook, angle, etc.) is not described publicly: unverified.
features.limits_or_cost: 10/month Starter, 50/month Premium, Unlimited Business.
features.notable: Metering AI analysis per ad separately from search keeps search cheap.

features.detail: Transcribes video ads into text. Output format unverified.
features.limits_or_cost: 10/month Starter, 50/month Premium, Unlimited Business.

features.detail: Brand tracker and Notifications are listed on all plans from Starter. Credit-era pages list Unlimited tracking lists. A competitor review says tracking lists can cover product categories or competitor stores, with alerts for new product launches, ad spend spikes and creatives outperforming others (unverified by Minea).
features.limits_or_cost: Starter and up.
features.notable: Alert types tied to change events (new launch, spend spike, outperformer) rather than a raw feed.

features.detail: Track Trending Shops shows traffic, revenue, top ads and the tools and apps a shop uses. Store Search works on Shopify sites only (Copyfy). Shops listing on Starter; Premium includes 10 shops.
features.limits_or_cost: Premium: 10 shops.

features.detail: 10 Winning Products, Every Day: daily trending products that already convert with top-performing ads. Daily niche lists and Monthly lists also appear in the plan table.
features.limits_or_cost: Daily niche lists on Starter and up.
features.notable: A pushed daily shortlist for users who will not search: a model for a daily 'proven posts for advisers' digest.

features.detail: Saved collections, Workspace and Lists appear as rows in the plan comparison table; per-plan values and behavior are not described publicly.
features.limits_or_cost: unverified

features.detail: Clicking an ad shows current stats and historical data, including when it took off, plateaued or declined; TikTok ads show engagement velocity charts (competitor review).
features.limits_or_cost: unverified
features.notable: Lifecycle view tells the user if a format is rising or already saturated.

features.detail: Facebook, Instagram, Google Ads, YouTube, TikTok, X, Pinterest, Yahoo, Unity, Pangle and AppLovin (ecommerce only). 1B+ creatives from about 10M advertisers, 80+ countries, 26 languages, ads from 40 ecommerce site types. Modules: Ad Creatives, Ad Copy, Ad Pages, Domain Analysis, Domain Advertisers, Playable Ads, Pre-reg Landing Page, TikTok Shop Ads.
features.limits_or_cost: Free: Facebook only. Starter adds Instagram. Growth adds Google, YouTube, X, TikTok, Pangle. Ultimate adds Pinterest, Yahoo, Unity.
features.notable: Platforms gated by tier is a simple upsell lever.

features.detail: Filters: platform, country, language, gender, ad format (video, image, carousel), video length (6s, 15s, 30s, 60s+), posting time, date range, industry, ecommerce platform (40 categories incl. Shopify, Amazon), call to action (e.g. Shop Now), engagement thresholds (like ranges 0-1K to 100K+, share, comment, view ranges), and an exclude field for unwanted terms that also reduces duplicates. Copyfy says there are no age demographic filters.
features.limits_or_cost: Free 10 searches/day; paid plans unlimited searches. Paginating 5 pages costs 5 queries.
features.notable: Exclude-terms field and deduplication keep the feed from repeating the same creative.

features.detail: Sort by last seen, created time, likes, comments, shares and duration.
features.notable: Duration (days running) as a sort is the cheapest proxy for 'proven'.

features.detail: Ad cards show Popularity, Impression count, Duration and Last Seen. Impression is BigSpy's algorithmic estimate of exposure and is stated not to equal view count. A third-party review says ads running 7+ days are treated as scaling.
features.notable: Shows an estimate but labels it as an estimate, which keeps trust.

features.detail: Three ranked feeds: Popular Charts, Rising Charts and New Creative Charts. Reviews also describe a New Trending feed of ads whose engagement spiked in the past 24 hours.
features.limits_or_cost: Growth plan and up.
features.notable: Popular vs Rising vs New splits 'already proven' from 'breaking now'.

features.detail: Trend research view of hot social search topics. Exact contents unverified.
features.limits_or_cost: Starter and up.

features.detail: Save individual creatives to a tracked list.
features.limits_or_cost: Total cap: Free 20, Starter 100, Growth and Scale 500 per seat, Ultimate 1,000.

features.detail: Follow competitor pages and domains; reviews say it logs each new creative and pulls each ad's landing page.
features.limits_or_cost: Not on Free or Starter. Growth and Scale 100 total, Ultimate 1,000 total.
features.notable: Follow-a-competitor is gated to mid tier: tracking is treated as the premium feature, search as the entry one.

features.detail: Inspiration tools: My Creatives, External Assets (a swipe file for creatives saved from outside BigSpy) and Research History.
features.limits_or_cost: All plans incl. Free.
features.notable: Lets users bring outside examples into the same library as found ads.

features.detail: Turns a found creative into an AI generation prompt. Reviews describe an Ad Creative Prompt Generator that builds creative briefs, ad copy and prompt variations from a product seed, competitor URL or top-performing ads.
features.limits_or_cost: Free 3/day, Starter 100/day, Growth and Scale 500/day, Ultimate 1,000/day.
features.notable: Direct 'proven creative -> prompt for your own version' bridge, priced per day.

features.detail: Extracts the spoken or on-screen copy from video ads as text. Exact output unverified.
features.limits_or_cost: Not on Free. Starter 100/month, Growth and Scale 1,000/month, Ultimate 3,000/month.

features.detail: Search the library by image or visual features rather than keywords.
features.limits_or_cost: Free counts toward 10 searches; Starter 100/day, Growth and Scale 1,000/day, Ultimate 2,000/day.

features.detail: One-click download of creatives; downloads use a separate daily counter from queries, reset daily, no rollover.
features.limits_or_cost: Free none; Starter 50/day, Growth and Scale 300/day, Ultimate 3,000/day.

features.detail: Configure a query once, name it, and reload it in one click; saved filters and searches sit in folders at the top of the dashboard.
features.limits_or_cost: unverified
features.notable: Saved search is a lightweight alternative to full competitor tracking.

features.detail: Scale plan: 5 seats (1 owner + 4 members); each seat gets its own Growth-level quotas (searches, downloads, prompts, tracked creatives).
features.limits_or_cost: Scale $399/mo or $299/mo yearly.
features.notable: Quotas per seat, not pooled, so one heavy user does not starve the team.

features.detail: Search 95M+ TikTok ads (Copyfy) plus Facebook, Instagram, Audience Network, Messenger and Threads ads by keyword, product image, landing page, ecommerce platform, ad copy or country. Top nav: Ad Search, Product Search, Advertiser.
features.limits_or_cost: 1 credit per basic search.

features.detail: Basic filters: region, call-to-action button type (Shop Now, Learn More), ecommerce platform, ad kind. Data filters: impressions, total likes, popularity score, days running, like rate. Categories: ecommerce, games, apps, dropshipping, brand ads, TikTok Shop ads. Copyfy suggests an ad duration cutoff above 21 days for proven ads. Sort by likes, comments, shares or days running.
features.limits_or_cost: Some filters premium-only (third-party claim).
features.notable: Like rate (likes per impression) normalises for reach, which suits small adviser accounts.

features.detail: Shows engagement (likes, comments, shares), estimated spend (Copyfy: 'a model, not an invoice'), country split, publish date, days running and landing page.
features.limits_or_cost: 20 credits per detailed ad view vs 1 credit per basic search.
features.notable: Charging detail views 20x a search prices the high-value action, not browsing.

features.detail: Track FB and TikTok latest ads from chosen advertisers, stores and products, with notifications when they push new creatives.
features.limits_or_cost: Trackers: Basic 2, Advanced 10, Flexible 20, Enterprise 100.
features.notable: Low tracker counts (2 on entry plan) make tracking the upgrade trigger.

features.detail: Every advertiser has a profile with full ad history, active and historical ads, creative volume, top performers and product mix. Copyfy cites about 700,000 advertiser profiles, refreshed daily.
features.limits_or_cost: 1 credit per advertiser lookup.

features.detail: TTS Ad Search, TTS Products, TTS Stores, Top Products, Top Stores, TikTok Shop Tracker and Search TTS By Image; shows sales estimates and shop-level performance.
features.limits_or_cost: All paid plans.

features.detail: Daily, weekly and monthly rankings of hot ads and products; Top Apps, Top Developers, Top Advertisers, Top Stores; #TikTok Made My Buy It feed; Search Ecom By Image to find similar products or ads.
features.limits_or_cost: 1 credit per ranking request.
features.notable: Daily/weekly/monthly windows on one ranking let a user choose freshness vs proof.

features.detail: Upload a video and get analysis reports, hooks, storyboards and script content.
features.limits_or_cost: Separate AI Tools subscription: Standard $11.99/mo 100 credits, Premium $16.99/mo 200, Professional $34.99/mo 500; pay-as-you-go 100 for $13.99 up to 2,000 for $199, no expiry.
features.notable: Output is hooks plus storyboard plus script: exactly the decomposition a remix step needs.

features.detail: Video Text Translator, Video Speech Translator, Video Text Removal, Image Translation and Image Text Removal, plus a linked AI Ad Creative Generator.
features.limits_or_cost: AI Tools credits (see Video Transcript Generator).
features.notable: Text removal then re-captioning is a cheap way to re-brand a proven visual.

features.detail: Credit costs: basic search 1, detailed ad analysis 20, advertiser lookup 1, product research 1 per item, ranking 1 per request. Credits reset monthly with no rollover; top-up packs do not expire. Pre-2025-08-01 subscribers keep 1.0v plans until they cancel; switching to 2.0v cancels the old plan with no refund.
features.limits_or_cost: See competitor pricing.

features.detail: Navigation: Explore, Category, Shop, Creator, Product, Video and Ad, Livestream, API. Claims 200M+ product records, 250M+ creators, 400M+ video and livestream records, 1000 days history.
features.limits_or_cost: Detail range 90 days Starter, 180 days Professional (Winning Hunter).

features.detail: Filters: category, revenue and units sold, growth rate, average unit price, creator count, conversion indicators, launch date, time window (e.g. last 30 days). Tables have sortable revenue columns with growth percentages.
features.limits_or_cost: Starter 50 searches/day and 100 detail pages/day; Professional 250 and 500 (Winning Hunter).
features.notable: 'Top performing' is judged by estimated revenue, not engagement.

features.detail: Finds creators promoting specific products, shows estimated influencer-linked sales, creator frequency and product overlap.
features.limits_or_cost: Creator contact export on higher tiers.

features.detail: Chat assistant opened from an icon at the bottom right of the Kalodata screen. Ask about market trends, best sellers, competing brands, popular videos and creator activity (e.g. 'What is selling now in Japan?'). Simple questions answer fast; advanced requests build report-style analysis from several datasets in a few minutes. Advanced functions: time-series trend forecasting, automatic extraction of success patterns across hits, Japan vs overseas comparison, timeline-level breakdown of video scripts. Reports share by URL and open without login. Planned: Amazon and Shopee data, PDF export, custom alerts.
features.limits_or_cost: AI points: simple question about 10 or fewer, standard analysis 10-50, complex report 50+. Launched 2026-03-19 (Japan).
features.notable: Shareable no-login report URL is a strong team/manager hand-off pattern.

features.feature: Kaloclip script analysis to original script
features.detail: Video script analysis breaks down the structure, selling points, hooks and CTAs of TikTok videos that performed well; script generation then writes an original script for the user's product drawing on those elements. Opened from Kalodata main menu, product pages and video pages; saved products and scripts feed directly into video generation. Scripts are editable.
features.limits_or_cost: Script generation free; usable without a paid Kalodata plan. Announced 2026-06-19.
features.notable: Remix entry point sits on the found video's own page: analyse -> write yours, one click from discovery. Free scripting, paid rendering.

features.detail: Input a product URL (TikTok, Amazon or Kalodata link) or product image; set video language, length, format, resolution and up to 1,000 characters of custom instructions. Output: product video with AI model footage, scene, camera work, narration and BGM. Tuned for Japanese narration. Planned: reuse one AI person from an uploaded photo, in-app editing, explainer formats, direct posting beyond US TikTok Shop.
features.limits_or_cost: AI points per video, varying by model, length and resolution.

features.detail: States data is collected from public channels and refined with AI models trained and updated daily; transaction amounts and ad spend may differ from real figures, and the data should not be used for commission settlements or performance evaluations.
features.notable: Plain disclaimer that estimates are estimates; useful pattern for any 'proven' metric shown to advisers.

features.detail: Open any TikTok account (own or competitor) to see video views, engagement rate, likes, shares, comments, sounds, historical growth of followers, likes and views, audience demographics and locations, Best time to post (from past engagement rates), and video research with filters.
features.limits_or_cost: Tracked accounts: Basic 1, Essentials 50, Advanced 300.

features.detail: Compares a video's performance against the account's other videos and shows its influence on account growth, including how many followers each video brings.
features.limits_or_cost: unverified
features.notable: Followers gained per video is a better 'proven' signal for advisers than raw views, and it is relative to the account's own baseline.

features.detail: Shows whether a viral video was promoted (paid) and compares its metrics to organic averages. Brand Comparison also splits organic, earned and promoted visibility.
features.limits_or_cost: unverified
features.notable: Filters out paid boosts so only organically proven posts count as inspiration.

features.detail: Hottest Daily Trends dashboard, country-wise trending topics, Uptrends and Downtrends (winners and losers), Custom Updates with viral videos in niches and industries you track, Related Hashtags. Exportable to CSV. Ranking method and refresh cadence not stated.
features.limits_or_cost: Data refresh 1x/day Basic, 2x/day Essentials, 6x/day Advanced.
features.notable: Country filter matters for a Singapore-only audience.

features.detail: Trending sounds with current hotness scores, up-trending and down-trending tracks, historical growth over a chosen timeframe, and video search by sound with performance scores.
features.limits_or_cost: Tracked sounds: Basic 1, Essentials 50, Advanced 300.

features.detail: Real-time videos, total views and engagement rate per hashtag; historical growth; Related Hashtags with performance and overlap rate; demographics of posters and audience; Today's hot hashtags by industry; CSV, Airtable and Google Sheets export.
features.limits_or_cost: Tracked hashtags: Basic 1, Essentials 50, Advanced 300.
features.notable: Overlap rate between hashtags shows which topics travel together.

features.detail: Research any topic: bundle hashtags into themes, see UGC share of voice vs competitors, audience demographics, who talks about the brand, and comment themes. Homepage promises an AI summary of what people say. Project setup inputs not documented publicly.
features.limits_or_cost: Projects: Basic 0, Essentials 3, Advanced 15.
features.notable: Comment themes reveal the questions an audience asks: raw material for adviser posts.

features.detail: NLP sentiment across any video or all brand and UGC videos; Sentiment Filter sorts videos into positive, negative and neutral; compare with other brands. Audio Sentiments marked Coming Soon.
features.limits_or_cost: Advanced plan.

features.detail: Transcripts of TikTok videos. Output format not documented publicly.
features.limits_or_cost: Advanced plan only.

features.detail: Side-by-side account comparison: Stats Overview, growth in likes, followers and videos, best-performing competitor videos, industry benchmarks, share of voice among similar audiences, and organic vs earned vs promoted visibility. Claims Spy Anonymously (competitor is not notified).
features.limits_or_cost: unverified

features.detail: Build folders of accounts, hashtags or videos to monitor; compare folders with a quick comparison tool for growth stats; folder notes visible to your team only; export CSV or Google Sheets.
features.limits_or_cost: Unlimited folders on all plans.
features.notable: Mixed-type folders (accounts + hashtags + videos) map well to a per-topic swipe board.
