features.detail: Pick an industry; accounts are segmented into brands, influencers and celebrities; Video Stats surfaces the most viral videos in the industry; Gainers and Losers; Niche Topics; Content Matrix; Real-time Trends.
features.limits_or_cost: Essentials plan and up.
features.notable: Prebuilt industry sets remove the cold-start of choosing who to track.

features.detail: Auto Tracking: add campaign influencers, videos and budget and metrics are captured automatically; Campaign Overview; Easy Comparison across influencers; Comments Monitoring grouped into themes; Influencer Finder with attribute filters; export reports and comments as CSV or save to folders.
features.limits_or_cost: Campaigns: Basic 1, Essentials 10, Advanced 100. Influencer Database for additional price.

features.detail: CSV export, Google Sheets and Airtable sync, custom reports on request.
features.limits_or_cost: CSV credits per month: Basic 100, Essentials 500K, Advanced 1M. Google Spreadsheet integration listed for additional price.

features.detail: Pricing page rendered in SGD with VAT 0% for a Singapore visitor; monthly vs annual toggle; free Basic needs no card; Paddle as merchant of record; invoice payment on request.
features.limits_or_cost: Essentials SGD 385/mo, Advanced SGD 920/mo.

features.detail: Breaks down a high-performing TikTok video: Deep Script and Keyword Analysis, Precision Timestamp Analysis (key moments), watermark-free video download. A third-party guide adds hook type, why it grabs attention, an opening strength score, pacing and selling points (unverified by FastMoss).
features.limits_or_cost: AI video transcription: 1 trial, then 10 or 20 videos/day by plan.

features.feature: AI script rewriting with similarity control
features.detail: One-Click AI Rewriting turns the analysed script into a new one for your product: Smart Product Highlight Extraction (benefits, pain points, uses), Enhanced Brand Messaging, and Customizable Script Similarity with levels from close to the viral original to differentiated storytelling. Output ready for filming, editing or livestream.
features.limits_or_cost: Video script generation: 1 trial, then 10 or 20 attempts/day by plan.
features.notable: A similarity slider is the cleanest UI for 'remix, do not copy'; useful for compliance with originality.

features.detail: Discover Videos and Monitor Videos; Discover LIVEs; Competitor Shops; favourites per section; video downloader.
features.limits_or_cost: Video monitor and LIVE monitor credits 10, 200 or 600 per month; favourites 100, 500 or 2,000 records per section; downloader 30 or 300 videos/month (plan mapping unlabelled on page).

features.feature: AI insight tools and developer access
features.detail: Voice of the Customer Insights (review sentiment), Video Smart Slice (auto-extract key moments), Product Title Optimization, and an MCP / CLI / API developer center for AI workflows.
features.limits_or_cost: Video Smart Slice 10/month on some plans; AI Entitlement purchasable by Standard+ main accounts.
features.notable: Exposes the data as an MCP server so outside agents can query it.

features.feature: Sound, hashtag and creator trend tracking
features.detail: Add specific sounds, hashtags or creators to track; time-series tracking separates a trend's rising phase from saturation; monitor own or competitor accounts.
features.limits_or_cost: Icon $299/mo: 50 songs and 50 hashtags; Mega $999/mo: 500 each; Trends Pro $99/mo.
features.notable: Rising vs saturated labelling tells a user whether jumping on a trend is still worth it.

features.feature: Viral Video finder and one-click saves
features.detail: Viral Video feature for finding trending TikTok videos; trending hashtag insights; save favourite sounds and clips in one click; save, monitor and compare influencers side by side; product sales data updated hourly.
features.limits_or_cost: unverified

features.detail: Finds fast-growing creators in a niche using creator-level engagement metrics, plus sound and hashtag tracking, for TikTok (and Instagram per some listings).
features.limits_or_cost: Starter $250/mo in 2022; pricing on request in 2026.

features.detail: Browse videos that got 50x or more views relative to the creator's follower count (UI label '50x+ Viral Multiplier'). Two views: 'Fresh Content' for recent viral hits and 'Most Viral' filtered by time range. Each card shows views, likes, comments, creator info, description and publish details across TikTok, YouTube and Instagram. CTA 'Start Discovering Outliers'.
features.limits_or_cost: Included in plans; credit cost of browsing not stated
features.notable: Follower-based multiplier needs no per-creator history, so it works on accounts never seen before; the API uses a median baseline instead.

features.detail: Add any outlier to a named collection for later reference from the outlier feed.
features.limits_or_cost: unverified

features.detail: 'New Agent' setup takes 1 to 20 keywords prioritized by order plus platforms (TikTok, IG Reels, YT Shorts, any mix). 'Run Mode' is 'One-shot run' (instant report, formerly Orbit) or 'Recurring - self-healing' (formerly Custom Niches) on daily, weekly or monthly cadence. Each run returns outliers, top creators, trending hashtags, slideshows, breakout sounds and duet/stitch chains, ranked automatically. UI shows 'Researching...', counters Outliers / Creators / Sounds, 'Format Intelligence' and 'Active Agents'. Nine in ten runs finish collecting in under 20 minutes.
features.limits_or_cost: 100 credits per run (USD 1.00); failed one-time runs still charged
features.notable: One object covers both a one-off search and an always-on niche monitor; agency math given as 10 clients x 100 credits x 4 runs = 4,000 credits/mo.

features.detail: Recurring agents adapt their search terms as the niche shifts and log changes per run, for example 'self-healed: +2 keywords' or 'stable'. Autopilot is on by default for new recurring agents since Sep 25, 2026.
features.notable: Solves stale keyword lists without the user editing them; shows a visible change log so the user trusts it.

features.detail: POST /v1/agents/search takes keywords (array), intent (free-text goal) and platforms (tiktok, instagram, youtube) and returns count of videos analyzed, number of breakout creators and recurring themes ranked by coverage. Sample agency report shows source videos, creator usual views vs video views, observed patterns and ideas to test kept separate from findings.
features.limits_or_cost: Usage-based from USD 5
features.notable: Report separates findings from ideas to test, a good pattern for compliance-sensitive users.

features.detail: Recurring agents detect confirmed breaking events in a niche; read them via GET /v1/agents/:id/events and receive webhook content_research_agent.event.detected (added Aug 7, 2026).
features.limits_or_cost: Events read is free
features.notable: Newsjacking trigger for timely posts.

features.detail: Input a video URL and platform (tiktok, youtube, instagram). Async job: POST /v1/satellite/video-outlier returns job_id; poll GET .../status/:job_id every 10 to 15 s (15 to 60 s typical). Result: video stats, creator profile, and analysis built from up to 100 recent creator videos: median_views (baseline), avg_views, outlier_score = views / median_views, percentile 0 to 100, std_deviation, z_score, performance_label. Runs are saved forever and listed via GET /v1/satellite/runs?type=video_outlier.
features.limits_or_cost: USD 0.50 (50 credits) per start, charged even on failure; 5/min, 100/hr, 1,000/day
features.notable: Paste-a-link check of whether a video really beat its creator's norm; tells users to judge new videos after a few days.

features.detail: Each checked video gets performance_label from outlier_score (views / creator median): mega_viral at 10 or more, viral 3 to under 10, above_average 1.5 to under 3, average under 1.5. If videos_analyzed is 0 there is no baseline and scores should be ignored.
features.notable: Simple four-step label is easy to show as a badge; explicit no-baseline state.

features.detail: Ranks outliers fairly across account sizes: weighted_score = ln(views / followers) x ln(followers) on hooks and agent results; the Satellite check uses ln(outlier_score) x ln(median_views), 0 if below median. Added as a sortBy option on outlier endpoints Apr 13, 2026.
features.notable: Stops tiny accounts with one lucky video from dominating a multiplier-sorted list; a 39K-view TikTok and a 1M-view Short can score the same.

features.feature: Creator tracking (Tracking API and Tracking Center)
features.detail: POST /v1/tracking/creators with platform plus handle or profile URL (handle wins if both). scrape_cadence: six_hours, twelve_hours, daily (default), every_other_day, weekly, bi_weekly, monthly. Optional collection_depth backfill: standard 50 videos, deep 200, full 500. Videos tracked separately by URL (TikTok /@user/video/ID, YouTube watch, youtu.be or /shorts/, Instagram /reel/ or /p/). Duplicate returns 409 free.
features.limits_or_cost: USD 0.25 per check; backfill +USD 0.50 / 1.00 / 2.00; app pricing 15 credits/day per creator, 10 credits/day per video; auto-pause after 3 failures or empty balance
features.notable: Per-item cadence lets heavy competitors refresh every 6h and long-tail ones monthly.

features.detail: GET /creators/:id/signals raises outlier_video once per video when it passes 3x the creator's median views; also follower_spike and follower_decline (at least 3% and 250 followers), new_subject and creator_unreachable. Webhook tracking.outlier_video.detected fires for new breakouts.
features.limits_or_cost: Signals list default 50, max 100
features.notable: Alert threshold (3x median) is lower than the browse threshold, so tracked competitors trigger earlier.

features.detail: Every check stores a snapshot: followers, total views and likes for creators; views, likes, comments, shares, bookmarks (TikTok) for videos, each with delta_* fields versus the previous check. Returns the latest 1 to 365 checks (default 30). Videos include transcript and growth_rate.
features.limits_or_cost: Reads free
features.notable: Delta fields make velocity charts trivial.

features.detail: GET /creators/:id/posts lists stored videos with stats, sound data and outlier fields, sortable by date or views. GET /creators/:id/posting-cadence returns total posts, average days between posts, posts per week and month and posts by weekday (UTC). Coverage per check: about 10 newest and 10 most popular on TikTok, up to 90 newest on Instagram, Shorts only on YouTube.
features.limits_or_cost: Posts default 50, max 200 per page
features.notable: Documents platform coverage gaps honestly.

features.feature: AI report per tracked creator or video
features.detail: GET /creators/:id/report and /videos/:id/report return an AI analysis rewritten on each scheduled check.
features.limits_or_cost: Included in check cost

features.detail: GET /v1/hooks/trending returns top opening lines from recent posts. Params: days 7 (default), 14 or 30; category (28 values e.g. finance); platform; language; content_type video/slideshow/all; hook_type or visual_hook_type; min_views; sort weighted_score (default) or views; limit default 20, max 100; top 1,000 reachable. Each hook carries hook_text, outlier_ratio (views / followers), weighted_score and the source video with thumbnail, views, shares, duration and author followers.
features.limits_or_cost: USD 0.25 per request, empty results still charged
features.notable: Hook-level dataset with a finance category is directly usable for advisers.

features.detail: GET /v1/hooks/search takes q (3 to 200 chars) or a hook type. Results ordered by match_type: exact, contains, then similar (only when q is 12+ chars), with match_score 0 to 1. Browsing by type with no q returns the strongest hooks of that type all time.
features.limits_or_cost: USD 0.25 per request
features.notable: Lets a user check if their planned opener already exists and how it performed.

features.detail: GET /v1/hooks/library: over 4,100 fill-in templates with [blanks] in 33 categories, each with example, psychology note and psychology_tags (e.g. 'social proof'). Filter by category slug, psychology_tag or q. Fixed order, not ranked by performance.
features.limits_or_cost: USD 0.10 per request; categories list free
features.notable: Templates with blanks are the bridge from a proven hook to a brand-safe rewrite.

features.detail: GET /v1/hooks/types aggregates by hook_type (15 types) or visual_hook_type (12 types such as text_hook, product_reveal, person_speaking_to_camera), filterable by platform and category, sortable by video_count, strong_hit_rate, median_weighted_score or p90_weighted_score. Returns share_of_corpus, median views and hit rates. Refreshed daily.
features.limits_or_cost: Free
features.notable: Answers 'which kind of opener works in finance' with numbers, not opinions.

features.detail: Each hook includes usage_count: how many posts across Virlo use the same words; 1 means original.
features.notable: Flags overused hooks before a user copies a cliche.

features.detail: Each hook object carries brand_safety_tier: safe, low_risk or medium_risk (can be null on some slideshows). MCP searches can filter on brand_safety_tier, is_sponsored and is_repost.
features.notable: A safety tier on source content is a starting point for regulated users; could extend to a financial-promotion risk flag.

features.detail: GET /v1/agents/:id/hooks returns top hooks from the videos a Content Research Agent collected, with coverage (videos_collected, videos_with_hooks), filters platform, hook_type, min_views, sort. No 1,000-result cap.
features.limits_or_cost: USD 0.25, free when no hooks yet or when Data Intelligence is enabled
features.notable: Hooks scoped to the user's own niche rather than the global corpus.

features.detail: GET /v1/sounds/trending defaults to sort=videos_7d (also videos_30d, usage_count). GET /v1/sounds/breakout ranks by burst ratio with videos_7d/30d/90d, burst_ratio and breakout_score. Reels page labels audio Rising, Early or Peaking and shows uses and growth (e.g. '2.4K uses, +340%').
features.limits_or_cost: Breakout USD 0.25 per call
features.notable: Trend stage label (Rising/Early/Peaking) tells users whether it is still worth jumping on.

features.detail: GET /hashtags with platform param; GET /hashtags/{id}/performance time series; Satellite hashtag lookups at GET /v1/satellite/hashtags/:platform/:hashtag with depth tiers and trend_analysis=true. Hashtag-style keywords normalize ('#progressivehouse' equals 'progressive house').
features.limits_or_cost: Repeat lookups free within 6 hours

features.feature: Breakout alerts to Email, Slack, Discord, webhook
features.detail: Agents and tracking send alerts 'when something breaks out' by email, Slack, Discord or webhook. Webhooks API /v1/webhooks (POST, GET, PATCH, DELETE) covers cycle completion, outlier detection, paused events, post collection, posting cadence, agent run completed and event detected. Tracking webhooks can post straight to Slack.
features.limits_or_cost: Slack/Discord/webhook alerts on Pro (USD 199/mo)

features.detail: Export any view as Excel, CSV, JSON or PDF.

Custom connector URL https://dev.virlo.ai/api/mcp/mcp (or 'claude mcp add --transport http virlo ...'). Claude can build an agent, run searches with filters min_views, region, intent_match, has_face_visible, is_repost, brand_safety_tier, is_sponsored, and get per-video hook_text, on-screen text, transcript, content_format, visual_format, setting, views, saves, shares. Corpus stated as 15M+ viral videos. Example prompt ranks by Virality Score, keeps top 24, then adapts top 5 hooks into a 20 to 30 s talking-head script citing the source video.
features.limits_or_cost: Pay-as-you-go credits for agent builds and searches; reading existing results free
features.notable: has_face_visible and region filters map well to 'real person, SG/MY audience' advisers.

features.detail: Seven GET /v1/raw/:platform routes return live TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels data (added Oct 18, 2026). Requests running past 27 s return 504 and are not charged.
features.limits_or_cost: USD 0.01 per call
features.notable: Data source is Virlo's own collection exposed per call; vendor not named.

features.detail: Analyzes Meta ad creative performance and competitor ads; API added Meta/Facebook ad discovery at POST /comet/{id}/ads (Jan 18, 2026).
features.limits_or_cost: Pro plan

features.detail: Filters: Saved Filters; Channels (grouped 'Your verified channels', 'Your watchlist channels', 'Other channels you've analyzed', default 'All channels'); Keywords (captions and titles); Outlier score min/max (3 = three times the channel's usual views); Views min/max; Engagement min/max % = (likes + comments) / views; Posted in last N Days/Weeks/Months/Years; Platform YouTube (Shorts only), TikTok, Instagram; Browsing mode 'Global Sandcastles', 'Your personalized feed' (default) or 'Your analyzed library'; Include analyzed toggle. Sort: Saved recently, Newest (default), Oldest, Outlier score, Views, Engagement rate.
features.limits_or_cost: Saved Filters and Global search need Pro or higher
features.notable: Three browsing scopes (global, my feed, my analyzed) are a clean mental model for one search box.

features.detail: Channels page has four modes: Suggested (from watchlist, or persona if watchlist empty; 'More like this' on hover), Describe (free-text description plus Platform and Account size Nano to Mega filters), Search (handle or name, 'Exact Matches' and 'Approximate Matches', only channels already in Sandcastles), Add URL (paste one or more channel URLs, 'Parse', results 'Successfully Parsed' / 'Failed to Parse', plus icon 'Add to watchlist' or 'Add all').
features.limits_or_cost: New channels marked 'New channel!' count toward monthly allowance; Starter cannot add new channels
features.notable: Describe-your-niche search plus bulk URL paste covers both cold start and power users.

features.detail: Channels per watchlist per workspace: 50 Starter, 150 Pro, 250 Visionary, 250 Titan. New channels added per month (shared across workspaces, resets 1st UTC): none, 100, 150, 250. When used up the UI shows 'Monthly Limit Reached' with reset date. Adding channels costs no credits.
features.limits_or_cost: See detail
features.notable: Meters only channels new to the database, so popular creators are free to add.

features.detail: Hover a video and click 'Analyze' ('Queued for analysis'), 'Add video URL', or 'Bulk Analyze' up to 100 videos. Card states: Queued, progress bar while analyzing ('may take a few minutes'), green 'Analyzed', or 'Failed to analyze' with reason; 'Out of credits' if short. Output is a Summary plus tabs.
features.limits_or_cost: 1 credit per video; refunded if it fails within 3 hours; Bulk Analyze Pro+
features.notable: Analysis is opt-in per video, so credits are spent only on videos the user cares about.

features.detail: Left: video, handle, posted date, outlier score, views, engagement rate. Right: Summary and tabs Transcript (word count, 'Show sections' timestamped split, 'Copy transcript', caption), Idea Analysis (Topic, Idea Seed, Unique Angle, Common Belief to Challenge, Contrarian Reality to Create Contrast, Supporting Evidence), Hook (Category, Formula, Spoken Hook, Analysis), Storytelling Format (Category, Description, Analysis), Visual Layout (Category, Sub-category).
features.limits_or_cost: Part of the 1-credit analysis
features.notable: Idea Analysis fields (belief to challenge, contrarian reality) give a reusable angle, not just a transcript.

features.detail: Buttons: Create script (C), Shortlist idea (S), Add to project (A), Save hook format (H, saves to 'Your Favorite Hooks'), Export for LLM (E, copies a prompt with the analysis), Open in new tab (O), Remove from library (R, irreversible after confirm). Arrow keys move between analyzed videos, Esc returns. While analyzing the page shows 'Hold tight!'.
features.limits_or_cost: Guests are read-only
features.notable: 'Export for LLM' hands the structured analysis to any AI tool in one click.

features.detail: Each analyzed video becomes an idea in Ideas > Inbox. Actions: Shortlist, Discard, Go to Analysis, Turn into script. Panel sections: Your Notes, Content Positioning, Storytelling Format (with 'Why it Works'), Contrast Mechanism, Hook Alignment, 'How to Personalize this Video for Your Content Niche'. Search ideas, sort (Saved recently default, Outlier score, Views, Engagement rate, Newest, Oldest), Export Inbox / Shortlist / All. 'Discard all' has no undo.
features.limits_or_cost: Created by the 1-credit analysis
features.notable: Inbox-to-shortlist triage turns research into a backlog of approved ideas.

features.detail: When the workspace Persona has a Content description, each new idea includes three ways to adapt the outlier to the user's niche. Without it, the idea shows 'Tell us what you make content about' and a 'Describe your content' button. Generated at analysis time only.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro+ (Persona)
features.notable: The remix happens at the idea stage, before any script, so users see fit before spending a script credit.

features.detail: Automation rules auto-analyze videos from the watchlist. Default rule 'Top Daily Performers (Sandcastles Default)' is off by default; when active it picks videos with outlier score 1 or higher, at least 25,000 views and 2% or higher engagement, max 3 videos per day. Automation ideas show a purple lightning bolt.
features.limits_or_cost: 1 credit per video analyzed; Pro+
features.notable: Daily cap protects credits while keeping the inbox fed.

features.detail: 'New Script' offers: Script from Scratch (type a topic, 'Continue'), Remix an Existing Idea (pick an idea, 'Create script'; topic, substance and writing style carry over), Fix an Existing Script (paste draft plus change request). Flow stages: Topic, Research (editable or deletable to use own research), Hook (keep, edit or generate new), Script (changes highlighted in yellow; 'Rewrite from scratch' or 'Edit script').
features.limits_or_cost: 1 credit per new script; edits, rewrites, translation and length changes free
features.notable: Staged flow (topic, research, hook, script) lets the user approve each step; free edits after the first charge.

features.detail: Configure > Persona has Content description (niche, 5,000 chars; drives channel suggestions and idea analysis), Context (business, brand, expertise, 5,000 chars; used in all scripts), Writing style (paste a sample script or transcript, 3,000 chars; no instructions). Autosaves with a green 'Saved' badge.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro, Visionary, Titan
features.notable: Writing style as a pasted sample, not adjectives, is a strong voice-capture pattern.

features.detail: Research > Reports. Inputs: channels, optional name, Schedule (Just once, Every day, Every 7 days, Every 30 days), Analysis budget (min 15 videos split across channels), Which videos (Most recent, Most views, Highest engagement, Biggest outliers), Lookback (No limit, 7, 30, 90, 180, 365 days), Exclude brand deals (drops videos under 2% engagement). Card shows 'Last Executed', 'Credits Per Run', Active toggle, 'Run now'. Outputs: past runs via 'Generated' menu, Export JSON, Email, 'Continue with MCP'. Verifying an account auto-creates a paused '@handle - Monthly Content Strategy Audit'.
features.limits_or_cost: Base report cost plus 1 credit per newly analyzed video, capped at budget; Pro+
features.notable: 'Exclude brand deals' by engagement floor is a smart heuristic for sponsored-post noise.

features.detail: Team-curated library of 100+ collections: 22 Formats, 30 Editing Styles, 47 Visual Hooks, 6 Signature Series. Browse by category, 'Search collections', 'Sort by'. Every collection has an Export button for a reference sheet for a writer or editor. New videos added weekly. Users cannot create their own collections yet.
features.limits_or_cost: Free on all plans; transcripts and export use no credits
features.notable: Editorial taxonomy of formats and visual hooks doubles as onboarding inspiration before a user tracks anyone.

features.detail: Server https://mcp.sandcastles.ai/ for Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Grok, Gemini, Cursor and others. Exposes short-form videos with outlier score, per-outlier breakdown (hook, format, story structure, angle), niche patterns across tracked creators, channel recaps and discovery, ranked topic ideas and scripts. Scoped to the current workspace. Example: 'Turn the best outlier from this week into a script for my channel.'
features.limits_or_cost: Pro+; questions free; analyzing a video not in library costs 1 credit

features.detail: Verify own social accounts to get a personal analytics dashboard and the latest audit. Verified accounts: 1 / 3 / 5 / 20. On-demand refresh every 12h (Pro), 6h (Visionary), 1h (Titan). Connecting accounts is optional.
features.limits_or_cost: See detail

features.detail: Separate workspaces each with own watchlist and persona: 1 / 3 / 5 / 20. Workspace guests (Titan) are read-only: can read analysis, copy transcripts, Export for LLM, but cannot analyze, script, shortlist or export ideas.
features.limits_or_cost: Guests Titan only
features.notable: One workspace per client fits an agency or a team lead managing advisers.

features.detail: Search a niche for videos that beat their channel's typical views; outlier score = video views / channel typical views (10x = ten times usual). Positioned on videos 10x to 100x above channel average; claims training on 62 billion YouTube views.
features.limits_or_cost: Free shows 5 results; research tools never use credits
features.notable: Unmetered research with metered AI generation keeps search friction low.

features.detail: Narrow outliers by outlier score, views, publication date, subscribers (e.g. channels under 100k), video duration, language and more; save the filter so future searches apply it.
features.limits_or_cost: Basic and up; exact ranges and defaults unverified
features.notable: Subscriber cap filter finds small accounts with replicable wins.

features.detail: 'Switch your outlier search to Shorts' to apply outlier search, Thumbnail Search, Similar Titles and Advanced Filters to Shorts only; results show outlier score and runtime; thresholds cited 5x, 10x, 50x above average.
features.limits_or_cost: Plan unverified on feature page; review calls it paid

features.detail: Describe a visual element in text ('before and after split', 'money falling from the sky') to see real thumbnails across YouTube, each scored against its channel's normal; or search a niche to see only thumbnails. Similar Thumbnails finds visually similar ones. Gallery tabs All, Gaming, Entertainment, Education, Faceless.
features.limits_or_cost: Free shows 5 results; full search Basic and up
features.notable: Search by what is inside the image, not by title, works for carousel cover research too.

features.detail: Track competitor channels; viral-video notifications by email and in-app.
features.limits_or_cost: Free 3 channels; Basic and up unlimited

features.detail: Overlays outlier multiplier badges on YouTube browse pages (including Shorts), views-over-time charts, similar video and thumbnail discovery, and change tracking with before/after view impact.
features.limits_or_cost: Free core; unlimited similar discovery, AI ideas and competitor tracking paid
features.notable: Scores appear where users already scroll, no context switch.

features.detail: Bookmark outliers; folders, swipe files and Vision Boards group outliers by angle.
features.limits_or_cost: Bookmarks free; folders Basic and up

features.detail: Generates titles and video ideas from research.
features.limits_or_cost: 8 credits per title or idea run; Pro and up per review

features.detail: Inputs: a title, a sketch, a reference image or your face; 2 to 12 variations per generation (Gen-2, Gen-2.5). Editing: Magic Eraser, Magic Edit, face swap, text and font controls, 4K upscale. 'Optimize' runs 4 packages.
features.limits_or_cost: 4 credits per thumbnail; Optimize 18 credits; Pro estimate about 200 thumbnails
features.notable: Reference-image input turns an outlier thumbnail into the user's version.

features.detail: Niche Explorer finds trending sub-topics within a category; Trending formats lists formats currently working.
features.limits_or_cost: Free shows top 3 trending formats

features.feature: MCP and API for Claude and ChatGPT
features.detail: Pro and Ultra list use inside Claude and ChatGPT via MCP and API.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro and Ultra; conflicts with older review stating no plan includes API

features.detail: Finds videos outperforming their expected reach in a category; each video gets a performance score; search by topic or by number of views.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro (about USD 49.99/mo per review)

features.feature: Thumbnail Search by URL and image
features.detail: Search thumbnails by words, video link or uploaded image to see which styles get clicks in a niche; 'Analyze Top Performing Thumbnails'.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro
features.notable: Image upload as query allows 'find more like this screenshot'.

features.detail: Alerts on trends using custom keywords and thresholds, e.g. when a video reaches 100,000 views.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro
features.notable: Keyword plus view threshold alert is a cheap way to catch topic breakouts.

features.detail: Collections organize video and thumbnail prototypes, ideas, clips and notes as inspiration and research boards.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro

features.detail: Track other creators' channels in your niche and the trends they use.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro; limits unverified

features.detail: Find videos that beat their channel's normal views on one channel or across a niche; sort by multiplier, views and recency. Works on any public channel, no account connection.
features.limits_or_cost: 2 credits per search

features.detail: Scores a video on hook strength, curiosity loops, pacing, emotional triggers and payoff.
features.limits_or_cost: 10 credits per video
features.notable: Named scoring dimensions make 'why it worked' comparable across videos.

features.detail: Maps a whole niche from one seed channel across thousands of related channels, groups them by growth, scale and momentum, and surfaces outliers, audience psychographics, sponsors, monetization and niche-wide comment intelligence.
features.limits_or_cost: 50 credits per run; Pro and Max
features.notable: Seed-one-channel onboarding avoids asking users to list competitors.

features.detail: Remote MCP gives Claude ten read-only tools: outlier search, similar channels, channel search, channel profiles, transcripts, comments, keyword ideas, latest uploads, video stats, live outlier refresh.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro and Max; transcripts and comments 2 credits per video; comments fetched live

features.detail: Add a public Instagram handle or a Reel URL ('track with just a link') and Shortimize pulls the account's historical video data. Covers Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook (Snapchat pages listed). 'Auto-Track Any Accounts & Videos'.
features.limits_or_cost: Unlimited accounts on all plans; video storage 1,000 (Launch), 5,000 (Scale)
features.notable: Unlimited accounts but metered stored videos is a different and generous limit design.

features.detail: Flags Reels that reach 5x the account's usual views; outlier detection can also apply to engagement (threshold unstated).
Choose data refresh of 1h, 4h, 12h or 24h. Plan defaults: Launch 24h, Scale 12h, Enterprise custom; 1h and 4h are add-ons.
features.limits_or_cost: 1h/4h add-on below Enterprise

features.feature: Keyword and hashtag account discovery into smart collections
features.detail: Add hashtags or keywords and Shortimize discovers new accounts, organized into auto-updating collections; collections also group accounts by purpose (e.g. 'Direct competitors - US', 'Aspirational - EU'). Similar-account suggestions from profile and performance patterns.
features.limits_or_cost: Smart auto-populating collections marked COMING SOON on homepage
features.notable: Grouping competitors into 'direct' vs 'aspirational' is a useful default structure.

features.detail: Automatic notifications to Slack, Discord and more; API, webhooks and MCP available.
features.limits_or_cost: API/webhooks/MCP add-on on Launch and Scale, included on Enterprise

features.feature: Instagram top post search with HQ downloads
features.detail: Search public Instagram profiles ('Search users') to see which posts and media types perform best; download the best posts in HQ. Explore-feed top posts need an Instagram login. Private accounts cannot be searched.
features.limits_or_cost: Searches 3 / 25 / unlimited; downloads 10 / 200 / unlimited; analytics 3 / 5 / 10

features.detail: Save posts to Favorites (paid plans). Each post tags its users so a repost can credit the original poster.
features.limits_or_cost: Favorites on Team and Enterprise only
features.notable: Built-in attribution of the source creator is worth copying for any remix flow.

features.detail: Brain stores the user's offer, audience, tone and content pillars and own handle. Explore videos are chosen from content pillars, drafts follow the voice learned from the user's posts, and the weekly brief compares the user's posts against tracked accounts.
features.notable: One shared brand memory feeds discovery, drafting and the digest.

features.detail: Creators search has two modes: Topic (accounts in a subject) and Account (@handle, name or profile link), then 'Follow'. Empty search shows suggestions grouped by topic with 'Follow all'. 'Similar creators' (layers icon) finds lookalikes. Scan takes 'a minute or two per creator'. Panel 'Creators you follow' shows usage vs cap. Private accounts return no data.
features.limits_or_cost: 20 Free, 70 Pro, 150 Business per workspace
features.notable: Topic-grouped suggestions with 'Follow all' make a cold start one click.

features.detail: Each creator page shows followers, typical views, posting frequency, best video length, hit rate, with Videos and Insights tabs; sort switches from 'Most recent' to 'Outlier score'.
features.notable: 'Best video length' and 'hit rate' are compact, actionable creator stats.

features.detail: Outlier score = video views / the channel's own median (6x = six times usual). Shown only once a creator has at least 10 posts; search results show no score because there is no creator median. Displayed as a badge above views and age, as a sort in Following and creator pages, and as an average per format.
features.notable: Explicit minimum-history rule (10 posts) avoids noisy scores.

features.detail: Following tab shows videos from followed creators, newest first, filterable by 'All creators'. Explore suggests unfollowed creators based on content pillars and searches Instagram, TikTok and YouTube by topic. Starters 'What's working this week' and 'Patterns across my creators' analyze the whole set.
features.limits_or_cost: Answers cost credits

features.detail: Library of recurring video structures, each broken into beats. Format page shows 'avg outlier' (e.g. 23.4X), videos and creators count, 'This week' count, a 30-day posting activity chart vs usual pace (2x pace = 'being picked up right now'), and examples sortable by newest, most viewed or top outliers. Opening an example shows a timeline of timed parts (e.g. 12s, 8s, 3s) with script and on-screen text per part. Filters: Film cost (no face on camera, needs other people, needs product or location, easy edit) and Hook type.
features.notable: Film-cost filter is ideal for advisers who will not show their face or film on location.

features.detail: Button on a format page sends the format to chat with the user's brand and voice attached, keeping the beats and swapping in the user's topic.
features.limits_or_cost: Needs trial or paid plan; credits per answer
features.notable: Remix keeps structure, swaps topic: the exact 'proven content into your brand' move.

features.detail: Four steps: follow and scan competitors; sort each creator by Outlier score; 'Ask Vamos' what the top outliers did differently in hook, structure, topic or format (plus a profile audit for coverage gaps); ask it to take the two strongest patterns and write three posts in the user's voice on the user's topics. Hook, structure and format carry over; 'Their topic does not'.
features.limits_or_cost: Credits per answer
features.notable: Gap audit (topics the audience wants that the competitor skips) adds originality on top of copying form.

features.detail: Monday morning by default (change day, time, time zone in Settings > Weekly brief). Up to five findings labeled Outlier, In your niche, Format or Your post, each with a 'Make this in Vamos' button that opens a prefilled chat. Requires own handle in Brain and 5+ followed creators (10+ recommended). Only sends when there are 3+ new own posts and 10+ new scored posts in the last 14 days; otherwise a quiet week with no email. 'Next brief' switch pauses.
features.limits_or_cost: Free on every plan, no credits
features.notable: Skip-if-thin rule and five-item cap keep the digest worth opening; one tap from finding to draft.

features.detail: Custom prompts that run on a user-set schedule and deliver by email and in app (Beta); e.g. weekly 'Patterns across my creators'.
features.limits_or_cost: Active routines 1 Free, 2 Pro, 5 Business per workspace

features.detail: Collections group videos and docs to hand to a chat together. Docs is a full editor where any selection can be rewritten, shortened or humanized, then exported.
features.limits_or_cost: Export and sharing on trial and paid plans

features.detail: Opening a chat is free; each answer shows what it cost under the reply. Quick questions cost a fraction of a credit, full research reports tens of credits.
features.limits_or_cost: Packs 1,000 credits USD 12 to 10,000 USD 109
features.notable: Showing cost under each answer builds trust in a variable-cost AI product.

features.feature: Creator baseline rules for outlier scoring
features.detail: Outlier = multiple of creator's median views over the last 20 videos by posted time, excluding videos under 48 hours old and the scored video. outlier_p90 compares to the creator's 90th percentile video. Confidence high with 5+ usable videos, else low and falls back to a follower-size benchmark (source field). Baseline stale after 7 days. Scores return null with reason aged_out after 30 days.
features.limits_or_cost: 9 credits per scoring
features.notable: Most complete published baseline spec: exclusion window, confidence flag and fallback are worth copying verbatim.

features.detail: Velocity = views per hour since posting over a stated window; percentile = position inside the creator's own sample 0 to 100; baseline engagement_rate = mean of (likes + comments + shares + saves) / views.
features.notable: Views per hour catches a breakout before the multiplier does.

features.detail: Scans 98M+ YouTube channels with RPM scoring and 21+ filters to find niches; Chrome extension adds 28+ features inside YouTube.
features.limits_or_cost: Pro tier; figures from competitor OutlierKit, unverified officially

features.detail: Outliers research over an 'Outlier Index' of 50M+ videos plus Brainstorm ideation, data-backed Titles and Thumbnails and a collaborative project planner, all in one plan.
features.limits_or_cost: Single plan about USD 49/mo per third-party; one channel; long-form only, no Shorts-only channels

features.detail: Database of viral posts for inspiration, alongside proven viral templates and AI writing prompts.
features.limits_or_cost: Unlimited on Creator (USD 97/mo); templates on Starter

features.detail: Remix any content across platforms, e.g. one TikTok into an Instagram post and a tweet, or three YouTube videos into a blog post, LinkedIn post and tweet.
features.limits_or_cost: AI credits by plan

features.detail: Save ads from Meta Ad Library, Instagram, TikTok, TikTok Creative Center, TikTok Ad Library and LinkedIn Ad Library with creative, copy, CTA and advertiser context into boards; search and filter by brand, niche, network, asset type and sort signals.
features.limits_or_cost: unverified

features.detail: Add a brand and Swipekit checks its Facebook Ad Library page regularly, showing how many ads it added over time.
features.limits_or_cost: Check frequency unverified

features.detail: Generates transcripts for saved video ads to study hooks; 'Video to storyboard' turns a video ad into a storyboard; Script writer drafts new scripts.
features.limits_or_cost: unverified
features.notable: Storyboard from a reference video is a strong bridge to a shot list.

features.detail: Learns a brand from one URL, studies competitors and customers, then remixes a competitor static ad into the brand's version (shown as 'Competitor static ad' next to the remix). Batch shows '30 ads ready' with 'Approve all'.
features.limits_or_cost: Static 5 credits, video 60 credits
features.notable: Side-by-side source vs remix plus bulk approve is a good review UI.

features.detail: Professional Dashboard menu -> Inspiration. Shows reels that perform well with the account's own audience plus trending tracks and sound clips, refreshed based on current trends and audience behaviour. A + icon in the top right starts a new post from the hub.
features.limits_or_cost: Professional accounts; selection criteria not published; no metrics shown on the page
features.notable: Personalised to what YOUR followers respond to, not a global trending list. Create button sits on the inspiration screen itself.

features.detail: Trending songs and audio clips in the hub carry a bookmark action so the user can use the sound in a future reel.
features.notable: Save-for-later on a single asset (the sound), separate from saving a whole post.

features.feature: Reels Trends: Audio and Hashtags tabs
features.detail: Reels Trends in the Professional Dashboard has Audio and Hashtags tabs. Third-party guides describe the trending audio list as the top 50 sounds used in the past three days, each with a count of reels made with it and an up/down rank movement indicator, with a save action.
features.limits_or_cost: Metricool says US only, mobile app, professional account. Top 50 / 3-day window is from third-party guides, unverified by Meta.
features.notable: Reel count per sound plus rank movement lets a user catch a sound early instead of late.

features.detail: YouTube Studio -> Content -> Get Inspired. Opens with nine suggested ideas based on the channel's data. Each card has a name, short summary, image, audience interest indicators, aggregated comment insights, prediction signals, Channel alignment (how it fits and what unique angle you bring) and Related interest (related videos with creator names, views, thumbnails and upload dates).
features.limits_or_cost: Desktop only, English only. Being deprecated gradually from August 2026; YouTube points users to Ask Studio.
features.notable: Every idea carries its evidence (related videos with views and dates) and a fit-to-my-channel line, not just a title.

features.detail: Prompt box and suggestion chips refine ideas. The + menu lets the user brainstorm from their own published videos. More like this on a card gives similar ideas; Show more gives nine new ideas. Back and forward arrows step through iterations, kept until page reload. Bookmark icon saves an idea. Feedback via three-dot menu: Helpful or Not Interested.
features.limits_or_cost: Prompts deleted after 45 days
features.notable: Iteration history with back/forward arrows; seed ideas from your own past posts.

features.feature: Idea to hooks, outlines, titles, thumbnails
features.detail: Selecting an idea shows generated cards labelled Hooks, Outlines, Titles, Thumbnails and Related videos. Thumbnail style can be set to digital painting, sketch or no images. Download thumbnail button exports the image with a C2PA manifest.
features.notable: One idea fans out into hook, outline, title and thumbnail in one view: a brief in four parts.

features.detail: Type Creator Search Insights in TikTok search (or Creator Tools). Lists topics people search for, sortable by category or For You (topics related to the creator's content). Each topic has a popularity score; a Recommended Topic label marks high-potential terms. Long-press to remove or report a topic. Third-party guides say tapping a keyword shows popularity by region and period.
features.limits_or_cost: Select regions. Searches by Followers needs 1,000+ followers per third-party guide (unverified).
features.notable: Search demand as an idea source, which suits explainer content such as finance questions.

features.detail: A filter for content gap topics: searched often but featured in few TikTok videos. Search value also feeds the Creator Rewards Program.
features.notable: Demand minus supply as a ranking. Copy as a 'questions nobody in your niche has answered yet' list.
